instruction: A blue tiger sits cross-legged on a floor cushion, one arm extended forward with the palm open and fingers gently spread, as if offering a small object to the viewer.
camera: Eye-level medium shot, slight front angle
visibility_requirement: The extended hand is fully visible with palm facing camera and all five fingers unobstructed.
intent_zh: 盘坐伸手展示掌心，递物姿态

instruction: The blue tiger leans against a kitchen counter, holding up one open palm near shoulder height while inspecting it, fingers casually splayed and relaxed.
camera: Slightly high angle, mid shot
visibility_requirement: Raised palm faces camera clearly; all five fingers separated and visible.
intent_zh: 靠柜台抬手看掌心，手指自然张开

instruction: Reaching up to a high shelf, the blue tiger stretches one arm overhead, palm turned outward toward the viewer, fingers reaching long and clearly separated.
camera: Low angle looking up, vertical composition
visibility_requirement: Overhead palm is fully presented toward camera, no fingers cutting off frame.
intent_zh: 抬手够高处，掌心朝外展示手指

instruction: Sitting on a park bench, the blue tiger rests one forearm on its knee with the palm turned up and fingers loosely curled, catching a few falling leaves.
camera: Medium shot, side-front angle
visibility_requirement: Upturned palm fully visible with each of the five fingers discernible.
intent_zh: 坐长椅接落叶，掌心向上

instruction: The blue tiger stretches one arm across a table toward a chess piece, palm open and fingers spread wide as it reaches, clearly displaying the yellow palm pads.
camera: Overhead tabletop angle, close on arm
visibility_requirement: Extended palm faces camera; all five long fingers separated and in frame.
intent_zh: 伸手越过桌面取棋子，掌心朝上

instruction: Standing at a bus stop, the blue tiger checks a wristwatch by turning one hand palm-up, fingers gently fanned to read the time.
camera: Medium close-up, chest height
visibility_requirement: Palm-up hand with watch is fully visible, all fingers unobstructed.
intent_zh: 公交站抬手看表，掌心向上

instruction: Leaning over a sink, the blue tiger cups one hand under the faucet, palm up and fingers together, catching water with the yellow pads visible.
camera: Medium shot from the side
visibility_requirement: Cupped palm faces camera enough to see all five fingers and pads.
intent_zh: 俯身水槽接水，掌心向上

instruction: The blue tiger sits on the floor and holds one palm out toward a curious puppy, fingers relaxed and slightly spread in a gentle stop gesture.
camera: Eye-level close shot
visibility_requirement: Forward-facing palm and all five fingers clearly visible above the puppy.
intent_zh: 坐地伸手安抚小狗，掌心朝前

instruction: In a library, the blue tiger turns a single page with one hand, palm angled toward the viewer and fingers delicately separated over the paper.
camera: Close-up over the shoulder
visibility_requirement: Page-turning hand visible with palm partly facing camera and all five fingers discernible.
intent_zh: 图书馆翻书页，掌心微朝镜头

instruction: Sitting on a porch step, the blue tiger raises one hand palm-out to catch a tossed ball, fingers spread wide and reaching upward.
camera: Low angle, medium shot
visibility_requirement: Open hand reaching up shows full palm and all five spread fingers.
intent_zh: 坐台阶举手接球，掌心朝上

instruction: The blue tiger crouches to examine a flower, one palm hovering open above the petals, fingers gently fanned to avoid crushing it.
camera: Low medium shot, side angle
visibility_requirement: Hovering palm faces camera with all five fingers visible above the flower.
intent_zh: 蹲下悬手护花，掌心朝下张开

instruction: The blue tiger sits at a desk and raises one open palm beside its face, fingers splayed in a playful peekaboo gesture toward the viewer.
camera: Front medium close-up
visibility_requirement: Raised palm faces camera clearly with all five fingers spread and unobstructed.
intent_zh: 坐桌前抬手做躲猫猫，掌心朝前

instruction: Balancing a book on one upturned palm, the blue tiger keeps its fingers spread and steady while looking at the cover.
camera: Medium shot, eye level
visibility_requirement: Supporting palm is fully visible beneath the book with all five fingers clear.
intent_zh: 掌心托书保持平衡，五指张开

instruction: The blue tiger kneels to tie a shoelace, one hand turned palm-up holding the lace loop with long fingers clearly separated.
camera: Close-up, high side angle
visibility_requirement: Palm-up hand holding the loop shows all five fingers and pads clearly.
intent_zh: 跪姿系鞋带，掌心向上捏环

instruction: Reaching into a backpack on a chair, the blue tiger extends one arm with palm open toward the viewer as it pulls out a notebook.
camera: Medium shot, front angle
visibility_requirement: Emerging hand faces camera with full palm and five fingers visible.
intent_zh: 从背包抽本子，掌心朝镜头

instruction: The blue tiger lies on its side propped on one elbow, holding the other hand up palm-out with fingers relaxed and slightly curled.
camera: Low eye-level angle
visibility_requirement: Raised palm faces camera with all five fingers visible despite relaxed curl.
intent_zh: 侧躺撑肘，抬手展示掌心

instruction: Standing in a garden, the blue tiger sprinkles seeds from one open palm, fingers spread flat and angled toward the viewer.
camera: Medium shot, slight low angle
visibility_requirement: Open palm is tilted toward camera showing all five fingers and yellow pads.
intent_zh: 花园撒种子，掌心倾斜朝前

instruction: At a market stall, the blue tiger holds out one open palm to receive change, fingers gently spread toward the vendor.
camera: Medium close-up, over the counter
visibility_requirement: Receiving palm faces camera with all five fingers visible as coins drop.
intent_zh: 市集伸手接零钱，掌心朝上

instruction: The blue tiger leans out a window and waves one open palm at a passing friend, fingers splayed wide and palm facing forward.
camera: Medium shot from outside
visibility_requirement: Waving palm faces camera with all five fingers spread and unobstructed.
intent_zh: 探窗挥手打招呼，掌心朝前

instruction: Crouched by a campfire, the blue tiger warms one open palm near the flames, fingers spread and angled toward the viewer.
camera: Low angle close-up
visibility_requirement: Palm angled toward camera shows all five fingers and pads clearly against the firelight.
intent_zh: 蹲在篝火旁烤手，掌心朝前

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a train seat and holds one palm up to inspect a small ticket, fingers delicately spread.
camera: Medium close-up, window light
visibility_requirement: Palm-up hand with ticket shows all five fingers and pads facing camera.
intent_zh: 坐火车看车票，掌心向上

instruction: Reaching across a counter to press a button, the blue tiger extends one arm with palm forward and fingers spread wide.
camera: Front medium shot
visibility_requirement: Forward palm with spread fingers fully visible pressing the button.
intent_zh: 伸手按按钮，掌心朝前张开

instruction: The blue tiger sits cross-legged on a mat and holds one hand palm-up in its lap, fingers loosely fanned for a short meditation.
camera: High angle looking down
visibility_requirement: Palm-up hand in lap is fully visible with all five fingers clear from above.
intent_zh: 盘坐冥想，掌心向上放膝上

instruction: Standing in a doorway, the blue tiger raises one open palm in a calm stop gesture toward a friend, fingers straight and clearly separated.
camera: Front medium shot
visibility_requirement: Raised palm faces camera with all five fingers straight and fully visible.
intent_zh: 门口抬手示意停下，掌心朝前

instruction: The blue tiger leans out from behind a tall wooden bookshelf, extending one arm toward the viewer with its palm open and fingers spread, as if offering a small brass key held between thumb and forefinger; warm library light and dusty shelves frame the gesture.
camera: medium close-up, slightly low angle, arm foreshortened toward lens
visibility_requirement: the offered palm and all five fingers are clearly unobstructed and facing camera
intent_zh: 从书架后探身，单手掌心朝前递出钥匙，展示五指

instruction: The blue tiger balances on a narrow steel beam, one arm thrust sideways for counterweight with the palm turned up and fingers spread wide, while a high-rise skyline tilts behind; the other arm is tucked out of frame.
camera: wide composition, low angle looking up along the beam
visibility_requirement: counterweight palm faces upward and every finger is separated and visible
intent_zh: 钢梁上单臂张开掌心朝上保持平衡

instruction: Reaching down into a rain barrel, the blue tiger stops with one hand just above the water, palm open and fingers spread as droplets leap up toward the pads; the forearm and cupped hand are silhouetted against dark ripples.
camera: top-down close shot, barrel rim framing the hand
visibility_requirement: the hovering palm faces upward with all five fingers clearly visible above the water
intent_zh: 俯身伸手到雨桶上方，掌心朝上接水珠

instruction: The blue tiger crouches on a dune and holds one palm flat above the sand, fingers spread, while a tiny fennec fox noses the palm; the long shadow of the raised arm stretches across ripples at golden hour.
camera: low side shot at sand level, backlit
visibility_requirement: the flat palm and all five fingers are silhouetted and clearly separated
intent_zh: 沙丘上掌心摊平让耳廓狐嗅闻，五指分明

instruction: On a windswept cliff, the blue tiger holds one palm out flat to feel the gusts, fingers spread and trembling slightly, while a kite string wraps around the wrist and the sea churns far below; the pose leans into the wind.
camera: medium wide shot from the side, strong horizon line
visibility_requirement: the wind-facing palm is flat and fully visible with five separated fingers
intent_zh: 悬崖边单手迎风摊开感受气流，五指张开

instruction: The blue tiger crouches on a rocky stream bank, one open palm hovering just above the surface as a trout leaps toward it, fingers spread and glistening; splash droplets arc between palm and fish in the foreground.
camera: tight low angle near water, fast shutter feel
visibility_requirement: the waiting palm is fully visible and every finger distinct against the water spray
intent_zh: 溪边蹲伏，掌心朝上等待鳟鱼跃入

instruction: Perched atop a lighthouse ladder, the blue tiger extends one palm outward to catch a drifting feather, fingers spread and slightly cupped; the curved lens room and spinning lamp glow behind the open hand.
camera: medium close-up, spiral staircase background
visibility_requirement: the outstretched palm is open and all five fingers are visible around the feather
intent_zh: 灯塔梯子上单手摊开去接飘落的羽毛

instruction: The blue tiger lies on a canvas of wet paint, one open palm lifted toward the ceiling as if halting the light, fingers spread and daubed with color; the studio floor around the sprawled legs is a swirl of pigments.
camera: top-down wide shot, body diagonal in frame
visibility_requirement: the lifted palm faces the camera fully with all five painted fingers distinct
intent_zh: 躺在颜料画布上单掌朝上，五指染满颜色

instruction: The blue tiger crouches on a dock and extends one open palm over the edge, fingers spread, as a curious seal pops its head up toward the hand; cold morning light catches water droplets between them.
camera: low wide shot from the water side
visibility_requirement: the extended palm is open and all five fingers visible above the seal
intent_zh: 码头边蹲下伸手，海豹探头靠近掌心

instruction: Leaning out of a train window, the blue tiger presses one open palm flat into the rushing wind, fingers spread and streaming backward; blurred countryside and a scarf snapping past complete the frame.
camera: side profile close-up at the window
visibility_requirement: the wind-swept palm is flat and all five fingers clearly spread against the blur
intent_zh: 列车窗外单掌伸入疾风，五指被吹展

instruction: Seated cross-legged among floating lanterns, the blue tiger holds one palm face-down above a paper lantern, fingers spread, as if sensing its heat; the reflection of the hand shivers on the river surface.
camera: top-down medium shot over the water
visibility_requirement: the hovering palm is open and all five fingers clearly spread above the lantern
intent_zh: 盘坐河面灯间，单掌悬于灯笼上方探热

instruction: The blue tiger crouches beside a garden hose and holds one open palm beneath the nozzle, fingers spread to test the spray; water fans between the fingers while sunlight throws a rainbow across the wet forearm.
camera: close-up, rainbow arcs across frame
visibility_requirement: the water-catching palm faces up with all five fingers clearly visible
intent_zh: 花园水龙头下摊开掌心试水温，水从指间流过

instruction: On a rooftop at dusk, the blue tiger holds one palm open toward a hovering drone that lowers a small parcel onto it, fingers steady and spread; city lights glitter below the outstretched arm.
camera: low angle looking up past the hand to the drone
visibility_requirement: the receiving palm is open and facing up with all five fingers clearly visible
intent_zh: 屋顶黄昏，单手摊开迎接无人机投下包裹

instruction: The blue tiger sprawls on a snowy slope and thrusts one open palm upward from the drift, fingers spread and dusted with snow, as if signaling a rescue; a distant mountain ridge lines the horizon.
camera: high angle looking down the slope
visibility_requirement: the snow-buried palm emerges with all five fingers clearly spread and visible
intent_zh: 雪坡上躺卧，单掌从雪中伸出张开求援

instruction: The blue tiger crouches inside a glass-blowing workshop, one open palm cupped near a glowing molten blob on the end of a pipe, fingers spread to judge the heat; orange light rims the hand against the dark shed.
camera: close-up side shot, molten glow lighting the palm
visibility_requirement: the cupped palm is open and all five fingers clearly visible near the molten glass
intent_zh: 玻璃作坊里单掌靠近熔融玻璃感受温度

instruction: Leaning over a rooftop pigeon coop, the blue tiger extends one open palm flat with seed, fingers spread, as pigeons land on the hand and wrist; the railing and rooftops blur behind the crowded palm.
camera: medium close-up, birds overlapping the hand
visibility_requirement: the seed-filled palm is open with all five fingers visible beneath landing birds
intent_zh: 屋顶鸽舍边摊开掌心喂食，鸽子落在手上

instruction: Crouched on a rocky stream bank, the blue tiger reaches one hand palm-up into the rushing water to feel the current, fingers spread and wrist turned toward the camera.
camera: Low angle near the waterline, hand in foreground, blurred stream and tiger behind
visibility_requirement: One palm fully visible above the water surface with all five fingers and yellow palm pad clearly shown
intent_zh: 蓝虎蹲在溪边，单手掌心朝上伸入水中感受水流

instruction: Sitting at a potter's wheel, the blue tiger holds one hand palm-up beneath a spinning clay bowl, fingers curved and glistening, checking its roundness.
camera: Over-the-shoulder close shot focused on the palm under the clay bowl
visibility_requirement: Palm pad and all five fingers must be clearly visible under the bowl
intent_zh: 蓝虎在陶轮前单手掌心朝上托着旋转的陶碗检查

instruction: The blue tiger holds up one hand palm-out at shoulder height, catching a falling snowflake, while its breath fogs the crisp winter air.
camera: Medium close-up with the open palm centered, snowflakes drifting past
visibility_requirement: The full palm and all five slender fingers must be unobstructed and clearly visible
intent_zh: 蓝虎冬季举起单手掌心接雪花

instruction: The blue tiger kneels beside a sleeping cub and gently rests one open palm on the cub's back, fingers relaxed and slightly curved, leaning in close.
camera: Warm low two-shot, palm and cub's fur in focus
visibility_requirement: The resting hand's palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible atop the cub's back
intent_zh: 蓝虎跪在幼崽旁单掌轻放其背

instruction: Holding a heavy glass jar with one hand, the blue tiger strains as its other palm presses flat against the jar's lid to twist it open, fingers spread wide.
camera: Close-up on the strained palm against the lid, teeth gritted above
visibility_requirement: The pressing palm and all five fingers must be visible against the lid
intent_zh: 蓝虎单掌压住玻璃罐盖用力拧开

instruction: The blue tiger bends low under a fallen branch and pushes one palm upward against it to lift, arm flexed and feet planted, twigs scraping its shoulder.
camera: Low side angle showing the upward palm and strained posture
visibility_requirement: The lifting palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible against the branch
intent_zh: 蓝虎弯腰单掌向上推举倒下的树枝

instruction: Balancing on a slackline between two trees, the blue tiger extends one arm outward with palm open and fingers spread for steadiness, one foot lifted mid-step.
camera: Wide side view with the outstretched palm sharp, forest below
visibility_requirement: The balancing hand's palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible
intent_zh: 蓝虎踩绳保持平衡，单臂外伸掌心张开

instruction: The blue tiger aims one open palm toward a glowing crystal in a dark cave, fingers spread as if drawing energy, the crystal light painting its palm yellow.
camera: Dramatic frontal shot, glowing palm in focus with dark cave behind
visibility_requirement: The glowing palm and palm pad plus all five fingers must be clearly visible
intent_zh: 蓝虎在洞穴中单掌对准发光水晶，掌心发亮

instruction: The blue tiger holds up one hand and counts on its fingers, tapping the thumb with the opposite index finger while the open palm faces the viewer.
camera: Close-up centered on the raised palm, softly lit
visibility_requirement: The counted palm with all five long fingers and the tapping finger must be visible
intent_zh: 蓝虎举起单手掌心朝前，另一指点数手指

instruction: Reaching beneath a low cafe table, the blue tiger holds one palm open to catch a dropped coin, fingers spread beneath the falling glint.
camera: Under-table low angle with the open palm in foreground
visibility_requirement: The open palm and yellow palm pad plus all five fingers must be clearly visible
intent_zh: 蓝虎桌下摊开单掌接住掉落的硬币

instruction: Kneeling on a beach, the blue tiger pours wet sand from one cupped palm, fingers slightly spread as grains and water slip between them.
camera: Close-up low angle with the cupped palm and falling sand in focus
visibility_requirement: The cupped palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible
intent_zh: 蓝虎跪在沙滩上从掌中漏下湿沙

instruction: The blue tiger holds one open palm above a candle to feel its warmth, fingers spread and eyes narrowed, the flame reflected in its palm.
camera: Intimate close-up on the palm and candle flame, shallow depth
visibility_requirement: The hovering palm with palm pad and all five fingers must be clearly visible
intent_zh: 蓝虎单掌悬在烛火上感受温度

instruction: Reaching into a crowded bookshelf, the blue tiger stretches one arm and opens its palm toward a high book, fingers spread to grasp the spine.
camera: Side overhead angle, hand at the shelf edge, books framing
visibility_requirement: The reaching hand's palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible at the shelf
intent_zh: 蓝虎伸手到书架高处取书，五指张开

instruction: The blue tiger crouches inside a cave mouth and extends one flat palm outward to test if rain has stopped, droplets splashing its open fingers.
camera: Side shot from inside the cave looking out, palm silhouetted against rain
visibility_requirement: The extended palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible against the rain
intent_zh: 蓝虎蹲在洞口单掌外伸试探雨停

instruction: Holding a magnifying glass, the blue tiger brings its other hand palm-up close to inspect a tiny insect crawling across its fingers.
camera: Macro close-up on the palm and insect, magnifier edge in frame
visibility_requirement: The inspected palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible
intent_zh: 蓝虎用放大镜观察掌心中的小虫

instruction: The blue tiger kneels at a fireplace and holds one palm flat above the hearth stones, feeling the heat rise, fingers spread and glowing warm.
camera: Low warm-lit angle with the palm and hearth in focus
visibility_requirement: The palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible above the hearth
intent_zh: 蓝虎跪在壁炉边单掌悬在石头上感受热气

instruction: The blue tiger holds one open palm under a leaking roof beam, catching drips, water pooling in its palm and splashing off splayed fingers.
camera: Downward close shot on the palm and drips
visibility_requirement: The catching palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible
intent_zh: 蓝虎单掌接住屋顶漏下的水滴

instruction: The blue tiger sits in a boat and trails one open palm over the side, fingers cutting a wake through the river water.
camera: Side view low over the water, palm skipping through ripples
visibility_requirement: The trailing palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible above water
intent_zh: 蓝虎坐船单掌划过水面拖出波纹

instruction: The blue tiger climbs a ladder and pauses to extend one open palm toward a bird perched on the rail, fingers still and hopeful.
camera: Side view from below, palm and bird in focus against sky
visibility_requirement: The offered palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible toward the bird
intent_zh: 蓝虎爬梯停住，单掌伸向栏杆上的小鸟

instruction: The blue tiger kneels in a garden and holds one open palm beneath a hose nozzle, testing water temperature, splashes scattering off its fingers.
camera: Close-up low angle on the palm under the spray
visibility_requirement: The palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible under the spray
intent_zh: 蓝虎花园里单掌接水管测试水温

instruction: The blue tiger lies on its side and holds up one palm toward a window, fingers spread to cast a shadow puppet shape on the wall.
camera: Side view with palm and wall shadow both in frame
visibility_requirement: The raised palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible toward the window
intent_zh: 蓝虎侧躺单掌朝向窗户在墙上做手影

instruction: The blue tiger reaches one arm deep into a hollow log and withdraws a pawful of seeds, palm cradling them, fingers curled inward.
camera: Side view into the log opening, palm emerging with seeds
visibility_requirement: The emerging palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible
intent_zh: 蓝虎伸手进空心木头掏出种子，掌心托着

instruction: The blue tiger holds a steaming bowl aloft on one flat palm, balancing it while climbing a rocky trail, fingers spread wide for support.
camera: Wide side shot with the balanced bowl and open palm sharp
visibility_requirement: The balancing palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible beneath the bowl
intent_zh: 蓝虎单手平托热碗，在岩石小径上行走

instruction: The blue tiger crouches beside a cat and extends one open palm slowly toward it, fingers relaxed and low, letting the cat sniff.
camera: Low two-shot, palm and cat's nose in focus
visibility_requirement: The offered palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible toward the cat
intent_zh: 蓝虎蹲下慢慢向猫伸出单掌让其嗅闻

instruction: The blue tiger balances a round clay bowl on its upturned right palm, arm extended sideways; the empty left hand rests beside the bowl's rim. The camera frames the raised palm and bowl in tight three-quarter view against a plain studio wall.
camera: tight three-quarter close-up on raised palm and bowl
visibility_requirement: Right palm with all five fingers and the bowl fully visible; left hand partially framed but not assessed for digits.
intent_zh: 蓝虎侧举右掌托住陶碗，展示五指。

instruction: Seated cross-legged on a low cushion, the blue tiger holds up its open left palm toward a shaft of window light, fingers spread and slightly curved, studying the lines. The right hand lies relaxed on one knee. Shot from above at a steep angle.
camera: high-angle overhead medium shot
visibility_requirement: Left palm and all five fingers clearly lit and unobstructed; yellow palm pad visible.
intent_zh: 坐姿俯拍，举左掌迎光查看掌纹。

instruction: The blue tiger crouches at the edge of a shallow stream, reaching its right arm down to press an open palm flat against the water's surface, fingers splayed. The left hand braces on a rock. Front-low camera catches the palm and ripples.
camera: low front close shot near water level
visibility_requirement: Right palm flat on water with all five fingers visible; yellow palm pad partly seen through the shallow water.
intent_zh: 伏身溪边，右掌按水面并展现掌心肉垫。

instruction: Standing in a workshop, the blue tiger presses its open right palm against a tall glass pane, fingers stretched upward, while the left hand holds a cloth. Camera looks from the far side of the glass through the hand. Tight chest-up framing.
camera: through-glass close-up, chest up
visibility_requirement: Right palm and five fingers spread visibly against the glass, palm pad readable; left hand holds cloth.
intent_zh: 隔玻璃按掌，展现手掌与五指。

instruction: The blue tiger lies on its back on a bench, raising its left arm straight up and spreading the fingers wide against a skylight overhead. The right hand rests on its chest. Camera positioned directly beneath the raised palm looking upward.
camera: low-angle upward view beneath raised palm
visibility_requirement: Left palm fully visible from below with all five fingers; palm pad clearly shown.
intent_zh: 仰卧举手，从下方仰拍张开的手掌。

instruction: Kneeling beside a large paper map on the floor, the blue tiger extends its left arm and presses an open palm onto the map, fingers spread to measure distance. The right hand pinches a pencil. Camera at floor level looking across the map.
camera: floor-level wide close shot across map
visibility_requirement: Left palm and all five fingers flat on map, palm pad facing camera; right hand holds pencil.
intent_zh: 跪地绘图，左掌按地图测量距离。

instruction: The blue tiger leans out of a train window, right arm stretched forward with palm open and fingers spread to catch the rushing air, eyes squinting. The left hand grips the frame. Camera shoots along the moving train from outside.
camera: exterior tracking shot along train side
visibility_requirement: Right palm open and facing the wind with all five fingers clearly visible; left hand on frame.
intent_zh: 探出车窗，张开右掌迎风。

instruction: The blue tiger stands before a large spinning pottery wheel, both hands cupping wet clay but lifting the right hand slightly so its open wet palm shows upward, fingers spread. Camera framed above the wheel looking down at the palms.
camera: overhead medium shot above pottery wheel
visibility_requirement: Right wet palm turned upward with all five slender fingers visible; yellow pad partly visible.
intent_zh: 陶轮上翻起湿掌，展示五指。

instruction: Halfway up a wooden ladder, the blue tiger reaches its left arm across to plant a full open palm against a high wall for balance, fingers spread wide. Its right hand grips a rung. Camera tilts upward from below.
camera: low-angle upward tilt along ladder
visibility_requirement: Left palm spread flat on wall with all five fingers visible; right hand visible on rung.
intent_zh: 爬梯横伸左掌撑墙平衡。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a boulder at dusk, holding a thin sheet of translucent paper up with its right hand, palm behind it and fingers fanning as if making a shadow puppet. Camera faces the glowing paper from the front.
camera: front close-up with backlit paper
visibility_requirement: Right hand's five fingers silhouetted behind the paper, all separated and countable.
intent_zh: 黄昏举透光纸做手影，五指分明。

instruction: The blue tiger reaches its right arm deep into a woven basket, then pulls it out with the palm turned toward the camera, fingers fully spread to reveal a small fruit. The left hand tips the basket. Medium front shot.
camera: medium front shot at basket height
visibility_requirement: Right palm with fruit and all five fingers clearly presented; left hand tips basket.
intent_zh: 从篮中取果，翻掌展示五指与掌心。

instruction: The blue tiger holds a large convex mirror in its right hand, angling it so the open palm and spread fingers of the left hand are reflected and enlarged in the mirror. Camera captures both the hand and the reflection.
camera: close-up capturing hand and mirror reflection
visibility_requirement: Left palm and five fingers visible directly and mirrored; right hand grips mirror rim.
intent_zh: 举凸面镜，映出张开的手掌五指。

instruction: The blue tiger kneels to plant a seedling, holding the open left palm upward as a small bird perches on it, fingers gently curved and steady. The right hand presses soil. Camera at ground level, shallow depth.
camera: ground-level close shot, shallow depth
visibility_requirement: Left palm uppermost with all five fingers visible under the bird; right hand in soil.
intent_zh: 跪地让小鸟停于左掌，五指平展。

instruction: Lying prone on a cliff edge, the blue tiger reaches both arms over the drop, right palm open and fingers spread toward the valley below. Camera positioned behind and above, showing the outstretched palm and the horizon.
camera: high rear-wide shot over cliff edge
visibility_requirement: Right palm upturned toward valley with all five fingers clearly visible; left hand also extended.
intent_zh: 趴在崖边俯身展开右掌伸向山谷。

instruction: The blue tiger stands in a bakery, right hand held flat and open as a hot bun settles onto its palm, fingers spread evenly. The left hand lifts a paper bag. Camera low near counter level to catch the palm under the bun.
camera: low counter-level medium close-up
visibility_requirement: Right palm supporting bun with all five fingers spread and visible; palm pad peeks out.
intent_zh: 掌心接住热面包，五指均匀张开。

instruction: The blue tiger crouches beside a telescope, extending its right arm toward the night sky with the palm open and fingers spread as if measuring stars between them. The left hand adjusts the mount. Camera low behind the shoulder, sky wide.
camera: low over-the-shoulder wide shot with night sky
visibility_requirement: Right open palm and all five fingers silhouetted against the sky; left hand on mount.
intent_zh: 观星时张开右掌测量星距。

instruction: The blue tiger stands at a sink, left palm turned up under running water, fingers spread and catching the stream, droplets spraying. The right hand turns the tap. Camera close at basin level, water frozen mid-splash.
camera: close basin-level shot with splash
visibility_requirement: Left palm up under water with all five fingers visible and palm pad readable; right hand on tap.
intent_zh: 接水冲洗左掌，展示五指与掌心肉垫。

instruction: The blue tiger balances on a slackline, right arm extended straight out with palm open and fingers spread for balance, left arm tucked. Camera low and to the side, capturing the open palm against the sky.
camera: low side shot against open sky
visibility_requirement: Right open balancing palm with all five fingers visible; left arm visible.
intent_zh: 走扁带时平伸右掌保持平衡。

instruction: The blue tiger lies curled on a hammock in late afternoon, lifting its left hand above its face and idly spreading the fingers to look through them at the sun. Camera from the side, close on the raised hand.
camera: side close-up on raised hand
visibility_requirement: Left hand raised with all five fingers clearly separated and visible against the sky.
intent_zh: 吊床晒太阳，抬手透指看光。

instruction: The blue tiger crouches behind a low garden hedge, extending its right hand palm-first through the leaves to offer a berry to a small animal. Fingers spread gently. Camera at hedge level, face partly hidden.
camera: hedge-level medium close-up
visibility_requirement: Right palm through leaves with all five fingers and palm pad visible; berry resting on it.
intent_zh: 穿过树篱伸出右掌喂食小动物。

instruction: The blue tiger stands in a rain shower, right arm lifted and palm turned to the sky, fingers spread to feel the drops, water beading on the pad. The left hand pulls its collar. Camera front low, rain streaks visible.
camera: front low shot in rain
visibility_requirement: Right palm up to rain with all five fingers clearly visible and pad exposed; left hand at collar.
intent_zh: 雨中张掌感受雨滴，掌心朝上。

instruction: The blue tiger sits at a low table playing a hand drum, right palm raised mid-strike above the skin, all fingers open and lifted. The left hand steadies the drum rim. Camera low across the tabletop toward the raised palm.
camera: low tabletop shot toward raised palm
visibility_requirement: Right raised palm with all five fingers open above drum; left hand on rim.
intent_zh: 击鼓时高举右掌，五指张开。

instruction: The blue tiger stands in a wind tunnel room, right arm angled forward, open palm facing an industrial fan, fingers spread and fur flattened by the gust. Left arm shields its face. Camera side-on at waist height.
camera: side-on medium shot at waist height
visibility_requirement: Right palm facing fan with all five fingers visible; left arm shielding face.
intent_zh: 迎风扇张开右掌抵抗强风。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a rooftop ledge at dawn, holding a paper cup in its left hand while the right palm rests open on its knee, fingers naturally curled, looking over the city. Camera wide from behind, palm toward lens.
camera: wide rear shot with palm toward lens
visibility_requirement: Right palm resting open on knee with all five fingers visible from rear angle; left hand holds cup.
intent_zh: 天台看城，右掌搭膝自然弯曲。

instruction: The blue tiger crouches inside a cave, extending its right open palm toward a cluster of glowing crystals, fingers spread wide, warm light on the pad. The left hand steadies a lantern. Camera low beside the crystals facing the palm.
camera: low close shot beside crystals facing palm
visibility_requirement: Right palm toward crystals with all five fingers clearly spread and pad lit; left hand holds lantern.
intent_zh: 洞穴中伸右掌靠近发光水晶。

instruction: The blue tiger stands at a large interactive wall screen, pressing its open right palm onto a glowing hand outline, fingers aligning with the diagram. The left hand points at a corner. Camera front, screen glow lighting the palm.
camera: front medium shot with screen glow
visibility_requirement: Right palm flat on glowing outline with all five fingers visible and aligned; left hand pointing.
intent_zh: 按掌于发光屏幕掌印上扫描。

instruction: The blue tiger kneels on a low wooden dock and cups both palms together to scoop up water from a calm lake, lifting them toward its face as droplets fall.
camera: Medium close-up, slight low angle, palms turned upward toward camera
visibility_requirement: Both hands fully above the dock edge, palms open toward the lens, all ten fingers separated and unoccluded
intent_zh: 跪在码头用双手捧水，手掌朝上清晰可见。

instruction: The blue tiger leans over a balcony rail and raises both open palms to catch falling autumn leaves, tilting its head back with a delighted expression as leaves drift down.
camera: Low angle looking up past the tiger toward the sky
visibility_requirement: Both palms face the sky directly toward camera, fingers extended, no leaves obscuring the palms
intent_zh: 倚栏仰头，双手张开接住落叶。

instruction: Crouched beside a garden bed, the blue tiger holds both palms cupped around a small seedling, gently patting soil with its fingertips while looking down attentively.
camera: Close three-quarter view from slightly above the hands
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible from above, palms angled toward camera with fingertips and yellow pads clearly discernible
intent_zh: 蹲在花圃旁，双手捧着幼苗培土。

instruction: Lying on its back on a picnic blanket, the blue tiger holds both palms up above its chest, fingers wiggling, watching a ladybug crawl across one palm toward the other.
camera: Directly overhead shot of the tiger on the blanket
visibility_requirement: Both palms face the overhead camera fully open, ladybug small enough not to hide any finger
intent_zh: 仰躺野餐垫上，双手举起让瓢虫爬过掌心。

instruction: The blue tiger reaches both palms toward a steaming mug on a table, fingers curled loosely around the air as if warming them, leaning forward with a relaxed smile.
camera: Medium close-up across the table
visibility_requirement: Both palms face the camera and mug, fingers spread and unobstructed by steam or mug
intent_zh: 伸手在杯子上方烘手，双掌朝向镜头。

instruction: Perched on a boulder, the blue tiger holds both palms out flat and level as a small bird lands on one, the other palm open beside it in welcome.
camera: Side medium close-up, hands at chest height
visibility_requirement: Both palms open upward toward camera, bird small and perched on fingertips without hiding the palm pads
intent_zh: 坐在巨石上摊开双掌让小鸟落脚。

instruction: Standing beneath a tree, the blue tiger holds both palms up together to receive a heavy falling apple, bracing its stance with feet apart.
camera: Low angle from below the hands and branches
visibility_requirement: Both palms cupped upward toward camera, apple landing in the gap without covering fingers or pads
intent_zh: 站在树下双手合拢接住落下的苹果。

instruction: The blue tiger crouches at a stream and splashes water toward the camera with both open palms, laughing as droplets scatter from its fingertips.
camera: Front low angle, hands thrust toward lens
visibility_requirement: Both palms face camera fully open mid-splash, fingers splayed, water droplets sparse enough to keep pads visible
intent_zh: 蹲在溪边双手向镜头泼水，笑着。

instruction: The blue tiger lies flat on its back on a wooden dock, both arms stretched overhead toward the camera, palms turned outward and fingers spread wide against the sky, while its legs dangle over the water's edge.
camera: low-angle close-up from above the head, looking down at the upturned palms
visibility_requirement: Both palms face the camera fully open with all five fingers extended and unobstructed.
intent_zh: 仰躺码头，双手举向镜头摊开手掌

instruction: The blue tiger leans out of a hot-air balloon basket and holds both palms out flat to feel the wind, fingers spread as the landscape blurs far below.
camera: frontal medium shot from inside the basket, hands toward lens
visibility_requirement: Both open palms face the camera with all fingers extended and fully clear of the basket rim.
intent_zh: 探出热气球篮，双手摊开迎风

instruction: The blue tiger juggles three glowing orbs, both palms facing upward mid-toss with fingers wide and alert, eyes tracking the highest orb.
camera: frontal medium shot, hands at chest height with orbs above
visibility_requirement: Both upturned palms and all fingers are visible, unobstructed by the floating orbs.
intent_zh: 双手抛接三颗发光球

instruction: The blue tiger floats on its back in a calm lake, arms spread wide at the surface, palms upturned and fingers relaxed, ripples spreading from each hand.
camera: overhead top-down shot at water level, arms and palms extended
visibility_requirement: Both upturned palms break the water surface fully with all fingers visible.
intent_zh: 仰浮湖面，双臂摊开手掌朝上

instruction: The blue tiger crouches at a stream and slaps both palms down onto the water surface to splash, fingers splayed wide, droplets frozen mid-air around the hands.
camera: front low-angle close shot at water level, palms flat toward the surface
visibility_requirement: Both flat palms are visible in the splash with all fingers distinct and clear of droplets.
intent_zh: 溪边俯身双手拍水溅起水花

instruction: Wading through waist-deep snow, the blue tiger pushes both palms forward to part a drift, fingers spread and dusted with flakes, leaning into the effort.
camera: frontal medium shot, palms pushing toward the lens through snow
visibility_requirement: Both forward-facing palms and all fingers are visible above the snow surface.
intent_zh: 齐腰深雪中双手推开雪堆前行

instruction: The blue tiger crouches low and reaches both palms into a glowing campfire to warm them, fingers spread toward the flames, face lit orange from below.
camera: front low-angle medium shot, palms toward the fire and lens
visibility_requirement: Both palms face the flames and camera with all fingers clearly spread and unobstructed.
intent_zh: 蹲在篝火旁双手伸向火焰取暖

instruction: Kneeling at a stream, the blue tiger lifts water in both cupped palms toward its muzzle, fingers pressed together tightly, droplets falling between them, reflection shimmering below.
camera: Front low shot near water level, hands and face mirrored in stream
visibility_requirement: Both cupped palms and all fingers above water, unobscured
intent_zh: 跪溪边双手捧水送向嘴边

instruction: Mid-leap between two rocks, the blue tiger spreads both palms forward to catch a thrown rope, fingers reaching, one foot trailing behind, mouth open in effort.
camera: Side action shot, rope arcing into frame
visibility_requirement: Both hands open toward rope, palms and fingers fully visible
intent_zh: 跃起双手前伸抓绳

instruction: Seated cross-legged on a woven mat, the blue tiger holds a large ball of blue yarn with both hands spread apart, thumbs hooking the strand as it stretches between its wide-open palms.
camera: straight-on medium close-up with mat texture visible below
visibility_requirement: Both palms facing camera, yarn strand between them, all ten fingers unobstructed.
intent_zh: 盘腿坐垫上双手撑开毛线，掌心朝前展示手指。

instruction: The blue tiger crouches inside a cardboard box cut with star-shaped holes, pushing one palm out through each hole with fingers splayed like star points while peering through the flaps.
camera: front view at box level, star holes and protruding palms framed symmetrically
visibility_requirement: Both palms protrude clearly from their holes, all five fingers visible beyond the cardboard edges.
intent_zh: 躲在纸箱中，双掌从星形孔伸出张开，展示手指。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a floating wooden raft, both palms pressed together in a tight prayer-like clap while wind blows its fur, eyes squeezed shut against spray.
camera: close frontal shot on the raft, sea spray and palms centered
visibility_requirement: Both palms pressed together facing camera, all fingers aligned and clearly separable.
intent_zh: 坐木筏双掌合十闭眼迎风，正面展示合掌手指。

instruction: Leaning out a second-story window, the blue tiger stretches both hands down to catch a falling bouquet, fingers spread wide like a basket below the sill.
camera: low angle from street looking up at the window and spread hands
visibility_requirement: Both hands extend beyond the sill, palms open downward, all fingers against the sky.
intent_zh: 探窗向下双手张成篮状接花束，仰拍双掌。

instruction: Sitting on a swing, the blue tiger holds both palms up to catch a tossed apple, eyes tracking it, fingers spread and slightly curved in anticipation.
camera: medium frontal shot with swing ropes framing the raised hands
visibility_requirement: Both raised palms face camera, apple above them, all fingers distinct and unblocked.
intent_zh: 荡秋千时双手上举准备接苹果，正面展示张开手指。

instruction: The blue tiger stands inside a large bubble wand hoop, pressing both palms outward against an emerging soap film, rainbow swirls around its spread fingers.
camera: frontal close shot with bubble film filling frame around hands
visibility_requirement: Both palms press the soap film facing camera, all fingers visible through the transparent film edge.
intent_zh: 站在泡泡圈内双掌推肥皂膜，正面展示掌指与彩虹。

instruction: Seated cross-legged on a low wooden stool, lean forward slightly and extend both arms straight toward the viewer, palms open and facing forward as if presenting an invisible object. Fingers naturally spread. Background: blurred workshop shelves.
camera: front view, slightly high angle, medium shot
visibility_requirement: Both palms and all fingers of both hands clearly visible, no occlusion from body or props.
intent_zh: 坐着向前展示双手手掌

instruction: Standing with feet apart, lean back and raise both arms overhead with elbows bent, palms facing forward and fingers curled inward as if holding an invisible large ball above the head. Torso twisted slightly to the left.
camera: low angle, three-quarter view from left, medium full shot
visibility_requirement: Both palms and fingers visible above head, not blocked by head or arms.
intent_zh: 双手举过头顶假装抱球

instruction: Balancing on one leg with the other leg lifted behind, arms extended sideways at shoulder height, palms facing forward, fingers splayed. Body leaning slightly forward, head turned to look at the viewer.
camera: side view from right, full body shot
visibility_requirement: Both palms and fingers visible against the background, not overlapping the body.
intent_zh: 单腿平衡，双臂侧平举展示手掌

instruction: Crouching low with knees bent, arms extended forward at chest height, palms facing up as if offering something. Fingers slightly cupped. Head tilted down toward the hands. Background: plain gray wall.
camera: front view, low angle, close-up on upper body and hands
visibility_requirement: Both palms facing up and all fingers clearly visible from the front.
intent_zh: 蹲下双手掌心向上向前伸出

instruction: Kneeling on one knee, torso upright, both arms bent at elbows with palms facing forward at shoulder height, fingers spread wide. Head facing forward, expression neutral.
camera: front view, eye level, medium shot
visibility_requirement: Both palms fully visible, not obscured by legs or torso.
intent_zh: 单膝跪地双手掌心向前

instruction: Sitting on the floor with legs stretched forward, lean back on one hand (but palm not visible), while the other arm reaches forward with palm up. However, for this task, both hands must be free and palms visible: instead, sit with legs stretched and both arms raised forward, palms up.
camera: side view from left, low angle, full body
visibility_requirement: Both palms facing up and fully visible, fingers extended.
intent_zh: 坐地双腿前伸双手掌心向上

instruction: Lying on back with knees bent and feet flat, arms extended upward toward the ceiling, palms facing forward, fingers spread. Head resting on floor, looking up at hands.
camera: top-down view, full body
visibility_requirement: Both palms facing up and fully visible from above, fingers not overlapping.
intent_zh: 仰卧双手向上伸掌

instruction: Standing on tiptoes, arms raised diagonally upward and outward, palms facing forward, fingers splayed. Body stretched tall, head tilted up. Background: gradient sky.
camera: low angle, front view, full body
visibility_requirement: Both palms and fingers clearly visible against sky, not overlapping head.
intent_zh: 踮脚双手斜向上伸展

instruction: Sitting on a high stool with legs dangling, lean forward with elbows on knees, but hands raised with palms facing forward at chest level, fingers loosely curled. Head tilted slightly to one side.
camera: front view, slightly high angle, medium shot
visibility_requirement: Both palms visible from front, fingers not hidden by legs.
intent_zh: 坐高凳前倾双手掌心向前

instruction: Sitting on the ground with legs spread wide, lean forward and reach both arms forward with palms up, fingers spread, as if offering something. Head looking down at hands.
camera: front view, high angle, full body
visibility_requirement: Both palms up and fully visible from above, fingers clear.
intent_zh: 坐地分腿前倾双手掌心向上

instruction: Standing on one leg with the other leg lifted and bent, arms bent at elbows with palms facing forward at shoulder height, fingers curled like claws. Body leaning slightly.
camera: three-quarter view from left, full body
visibility_requirement: Both palms and curled fingers visible, not hidden by body.
intent_zh: 单腿站立双手爪状掌心向前

instruction: Crouching with knees bent and back straight, arms extended sideways with palms facing forward, fingers splayed. Head turned to look at the camera. Background: forest.
camera: front view, low angle, medium shot
visibility_requirement: Both palms visible from front, fingers not overlapping legs.
intent_zh: 蹲下双臂侧伸掌心向前

instruction: Standing with back to a wall, arms raised above head with palms flat against the wall (but palms not visible to camera). Instead, for this task, stand facing the wall with arms raised and palms flat on wall, but then camera is behind. Not good. Instead, stand with back to wall, arms raised forward with palms facing forward, as if pushing an invisible wall in front.
camera: front view, eye level, medium shot
visibility_requirement: Both palms facing forward and fully visible, fingers spread.
intent_zh: 站立双手前推掌心向前

instruction: Sitting on a swing (but hands free), legs dangling, arms raised forward with palms up, fingers spread. Body swinging slightly. Background: playground.
camera: front view, slightly low angle, medium full shot
visibility_requirement: Both palms up and visible, not holding swing chains.
intent_zh: 荡秋千双手前伸掌心向上

instruction: The blue tiger leans far forward from a low crouch, both arms thrust down and forward with palms open toward the viewer, shoulders rotated inward, as if presenting its palms through a low camera window.
camera: extreme low angle, wide lens, looking up at chest level
visibility_requirement: Both open palms face the camera, all ten fingers separated and unobstructed.
intent_zh: 低角度呈现双掌，身体前倾下蹲

instruction: Standing on tiptoe on a narrow beam, the tiger twists its torso and raises both arms overhead in an open V, palms turned outward to the sky, balancing with bent knees and a lifted heel.
camera: slightly high angle, three-quarter view, full body
visibility_requirement: Both raised palms angled toward the viewer, all digits distinguishable against the sky.
intent_zh: 窄梁上踮脚平衡，双臂上举展示掌心

instruction: Seated cross-legged on a studio floor, the tiger leans back on an invisible support and holds both hands up like open books at chest height, palms facing the lens, fingers spread wide.
camera: eye-level, medium shot, slight left three-quarter
visibility_requirement: Both palms fully face camera, no finger overlap; wrists and forearms visible.
intent_zh: 盘坐展示双掌如翻开书本

instruction: Mid-jump between two boulders, the blue tiger splays both arms sideways with palms facing forward, legs tucked, tail streaming behind, capturing the moment both open hands block the horizon.
camera: front view, slight low angle, fast shutter, full body
visibility_requirement: Both spread palms face the lens, fingers clearly separated, no motion blur on hands.
intent_zh: 跳跃中双臂展开，双掌朝向镜头

instruction: Bent backward in an arch, the blue tiger lets both arms hang down behind its head with palms turned up toward the camera, head tilted, emphasizing a stretched spine and open upturned hands.
camera: low front angle, close on torso and hands
visibility_requirement: Both upturned palms visible beside the head, fingers separated and clear of fur.
intent_zh: 后仰伸展，掌心向上置于头后

instruction: Sitting on a high stool with legs dangling, the blue tiger leans forward between its knees and holds both hands out palms-up like an open offering, elbows on knees, looking down at the camera.
camera: high angle looking down, medium shot
visibility_requirement: Both open upturned palms face camera, fingers fully visible, not hidden by knees.
intent_zh: 高凳俯身，双掌上摊如献物

instruction: Twisting at the waist, the tiger extends one arm high and one low, both palms open toward the lens, feet planted wide, creating a diagonal composition of two visible palm surfaces.
camera: eye-level, diagonal composition, full body
visibility_requirement: High and low palms both face camera, all ten fingers visible and unoccluded.
intent_zh: 扭腰对角伸展，一高一低双掌朝镜头

instruction: Lying on its back on a low platform, the blue tiger raises both arms straight up with palms facing the camera, knees bent, head turned to one side, shot from directly above.
camera: top-down overhead view, full body
visibility_requirement: Both palms face the overhead lens, fingers splayed and clear, no arm crossing.
intent_zh: 仰卧平台，双臂上举双掌朝向俯拍镜头

instruction: The tiger steps out from behind a doorway, half its body shown, both hands emerging first with palms open toward the viewer at shoulder height, fingers relaxed and slightly spread.
camera: front, medium shot framed by door
visibility_requirement: Both palms clear of the doorframe, all fingers visible, no edge cropping.
intent_zh: 自门框探身，双手先出展示掌心

instruction: Perched on a boulder edge, the blue tiger leans out and holds both hands forward palms-down, then tilts wrists so the palm surfaces angle toward the camera, legs braced behind.
camera: side three-quarter, low angle, medium
visibility_requirement: Wrist tilt reveals both palm surfaces toward camera, fingers separated and visible.
intent_zh: 岩边前倾，手腕翻转露出双掌

instruction: Crouched low with knees wide, the blue tiger brings both open hands close to the camera at the bottom of frame, palms flat toward the lens, head peering over them from behind.
camera: very low, close-up foreground hands, face behind
visibility_requirement: Both foreground palms fill clear space, all digits visible, face behind does not occlude.
intent_zh: 低蹲，双手贴近镜头前置展示掌心

instruction: Sitting on a swing, the tiger leans back and opens both arms wide with palms facing forward, feet lifted, the swing ropes passing behind the wrists without covering the palms.
camera: front, eye-level, medium full shot
visibility_requirement: Both palms unobstructed by ropes, all fingers visible against the background.
intent_zh: 荡秋千时双臂张开，双掌朝前

instruction: The tiger balances on one leg with the other knee raised, both palms held out at waist height facing forward, as if steadying an invisible frame around its body.
camera: slightly low, three-quarter, full body
visibility_requirement: Both waist-height palms face camera, fingers clear of the raised knee.
intent_zh: 单腿平衡，双掌在腰高朝前框住身体

instruction: Lunging forward in a deep fencer's stance, the blue tiger throws both open hands toward the camera at different depths, one nearer and one farther, palms fully facing the lens.
camera: front, wide angle exaggerating depth
visibility_requirement: Near and far palms both face camera, all fingers of each hand distinguishable.
intent_zh: 弓步前冲，远近两只手掌均朝镜头

instruction: Hanging by its knees from a horizontal bar, the blue tiger lets both arms dangle and turns palms outward toward the viewer, head upside down, fur falling away from open fingers.
camera: low angle looking up, medium shot
visibility_requirement: Both dangling palms face the low lens, all fingers separated and visible.
intent_zh: 倒挂横杆，双臂下垂翻掌朝镜头

instruction: The tiger sits on a low wall and leans to one side, one hand held high and one low, both palms open toward the camera like a jazz-hands diagonal, shoulders tilted.
camera: eye-level, slight tilt, medium shot
visibility_requirement: Diagonal high and low palms both face camera, all ten fingers clear.
intent_zh: 矮墙斜坐，双掌对角高低展示

instruction: Stepping through shallow water, the blue tiger raises both open palms at chest height to show they are dry, water rippling at its ankles, body angled toward the lens.
camera: front three-quarter, medium wide, low
visibility_requirement: Both chest-height palms face camera, fingers visible, no water splash covering hands.
intent_zh: 涉水行走，胸前展示干燥双掌

instruction: The tiger leans around a thick tree trunk, upper body visible, both hands reaching forward past the trunk with palms open toward the viewer, fingers spread like leaves.
camera: front, medium close, tree framing left
visibility_requirement: Both palms clear of trunk, all fingers visible against background.
intent_zh: 绕树干探身，双掌前伸如叶展开

instruction: The blue tiger does a deep side bend, one arm reaching over the head and the other pointing down, both palms open toward the viewer, hips shifted to emphasize the curve.
camera: front, full body, medium wide
visibility_requirement: Overhead palm and low palm both face camera, all fingers distinct and unoccluded.
intent_zh: 侧弯伸展，一上一下双掌朝观众

instruction: Crawling forward on elbows and knees, the tiger lifts both forearms off the ground and shows open palms to the camera, chest low, tail raised, like a playful pause.
camera: front low angle, ground level, medium
visibility_requirement: Both lifted palms face camera, fingers splayed, clear of floor and fur.
intent_zh: 爬行中抬起前臂，双掌展示给镜头

instruction: Standing on a rotating platform, the tiger opens both arms to the sides with palms forward and chin lifted, captured as the platform turns so both open hands read symmetrically.
camera: front, eye-level, symmetrical medium shot
visibility_requirement: Both symmetric palms face camera, all ten fingers visible and evenly lit.
intent_zh: 旋转台上双臂侧展，双掌对称朝前

instruction: The tiger crouches under a low overhang, forced to bend, and holds both palms up near its shoulders as if pushing up the ceiling, fingers spread against imagined surface.
camera: low angle, cramped framing, medium close
visibility_requirement: Both raised palms face camera under overhang, fingers clear of ceiling edge.
intent_zh: 低檐下蹲，双掌上推展示掌心

instruction: Leaning out from a window, the blue tiger rests both forearms on the sill but keeps palms turned up toward the street camera, fingers relaxed and slightly curled.
camera: street-level low angle looking up at window
visibility_requirement: Both upturned palms visible above sill, all fingers distinct, sill does not hide digits.
