visibility_requirement: Right sole and four toes visible as the hand holds the toes.
intent_zh: 老虎坐地前屈抓右脚趾拉伸，脚底朝上可见。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a chair and lifts its right foot onto the seat beside its hip, turning the sole to face out while it clips a small bandage onto a toe.
camera: High side view focusing on the upturned sole and hands.
visibility_requirement: Right sole and toes visible, hands do not fully cover the sole.
intent_zh: 老虎坐椅将右脚放身侧，贴创可贴展示脚底。

instruction: The blue tiger sits leaning against a tree, one knee up, and rests the opposite ankle on that knee so the sole faces the viewer while it tosses a small ball with one hand.
camera: Front eye-level view centered on the crossed ankle and sole.
visibility_requirement: Raised sole and four toes fully visible above the knee.
intent_zh: 老虎靠树坐着，脚踝搭膝上展示脚底并抛球。

instruction: The blue tiger crouches on a beach and lifts its right foot sideways to shake off sand, sole turned outward to the camera, one hand shielding its eyes from the sun.
camera: Low front-side angle with the lifted sole toward camera.
visibility_requirement: Right outward sole and four toes clearly visible, sand does not obscure toes.
intent_zh: 老虎蹲沙滩侧抬右脚抖沙，脚底朝镜头。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a low wall and dangles both legs, crossing its right leg over the left so the right sole turns toward the viewer as it hums and sways.
camera: Front medium-low view from below the wall, right sole toward camera.
visibility_requirement: Right crossed sole and toes visible against the sky or wall.
intent_zh: 老虎坐矮墙摇腿交叠，右脚底朝向镜头。

instruction: The blue tiger lies on its stomach on the floor, bending both knees to raise its feet, and twists the right ankle so that sole faces the viewer while reading a book propped open.
camera: Rear high angle over the tiger's back toward the raised right sole.
visibility_requirement: Right raised sole and toes visible above the body, book elsewhere.
intent_zh: 老虎趴地屈膝抬脚阅读，右脚底朝上可见。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a kitchen counter and lifts its right foot toward the sink faucet, sole tilted up to the viewer, while turning the tap with one hand.
camera: Side-front view at counter height, upturned sole toward camera.
visibility_requirement: Right sole and four toes visible, faucet does not block the foot.
intent_zh: 老虎坐柜台抬右脚冲水，脚底朝镜头可见。

instruction: The blue tiger balances on a skateboard, kicking its right foot up behind it so the sole faces the viewer, one arm extended for balance as it rolls slowly.
camera: Low side tracking view toward the raised right sole.
visibility_requirement: Raised right sole and four toes visible behind the board.
intent_zh: 老虎滑板后抬脚平衡，右脚底朝镜头。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a park bench and stretches its right leg out along the bench, heel resting on the far armrest with sole facing the camera as it opens a snack bag.
camera: Side low view along the bench toward the sole.
visibility_requirement: Right sole and four toes facing camera, armrest does not hide them.
intent_zh: 老虎坐长椅伸直右腿，脚底对镜头吃零食。

instruction: The blue tiger kneels and tucks its right foot under itself, then leans back and lifts the knee so the right sole flashes toward the viewer while holding a camera up with one hand.
camera: High front angle capturing the flashed sole and the held camera.
visibility_requirement: Right sole and toes visible as the knee lifts, camera does not block foot.
intent_zh: 老虎跪姿抬膝露右脚底并举相机拍照。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a pile of cushions and raises its right foot to its ear as if listening, sole turned fully to the viewer, the other hand tapping its chin thoughtfully.
camera: Front close view on the raised foot beside the head.
visibility_requirement: Right sole and all four toes visible next to the head.
intent_zh: 老虎坐垫堆抬脚贴耳倾听，脚底正对镜头。

instruction: The blue tiger stands in a doorway and hooks its right foot behind the doorframe, sole turned toward the viewer, leaning casually while checking a wristwatch.
camera: Front angle slightly low, framed by the doorway on the hooked sole.
visibility_requirement: Hooked right sole and four toes visible against the frame.
intent_zh: 老虎靠门框钩脚，右脚底朝镜头看表。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a rocking chair and props its right foot on the chair's front rail, sole facing outward toward the viewer, while slowly rocking and knitting with both hands.
camera: Side-front low view toward the propped sole.
visibility_requirement: Right sole and toes visible above the rail, knitting stays near the lap.
intent_zh: 老虎坐摇椅脚搭横杆织毛线，脚底朝外可见。

instruction: The blue tiger crouches low near a campfire and extends its right leg to the side, turning the sole up toward the viewer to warm it while poking the fire with a stick.
camera: Low side view with the upturned sole toward camera.
visibility_requirement: Right sole and four toes visible toward the fire, stick does not block foot.
intent_zh: 老虎蹲营火旁侧伸脚取暖，脚底朝镜头。

instruction: The blue tiger reclines on a picnic blanket and raises its right leg straight up, gripping the calf with one hand so the sole faces the viewer while a breeze flutters nearby leaves.
camera: Low top-down angle toward the vertical right sole.
visibility_requirement: Vertical right sole and four toes clearly visible above the body.
intent_zh: 老虎躺野餐垫竖直抬腿，右脚底正对镜头。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a low wooden stool and lifts one leg straight out toward the viewer, pressing that foot flat against the lens so four toes and yellow pads fill the frame.
camera: Extreme close-up, foot thrust toward camera, stool and torso blurred behind
visibility_requirement: The raised sole and all four toes are fully visible, unobstructed by the other leg.
intent_zh: 坐姿将脚掌正对镜头，展示四趾与黄色肉垫。

instruction: Balanced on a narrow garden beam, the tiger lifts one hind foot behind and twists to look back at it, sole angled upward.
camera: Low three-quarter rear view, beam cutting diagonally, sky behind
visibility_requirement: The lifted rear sole is clear and all four toes visible against the sky.
intent_zh: 在窄梁上保持平衡，回身查看抬起的脚掌。

instruction: Lying on a yoga mat, the tiger pulls one knee to its chest and rolls that leg outward, exposing the upturned sole while the other leg stays long on the mat.
camera: High overhead shot looking down at the mat, body foreshortened
visibility_requirement: The upturned sole faces the overhead camera fully, all four toes separated and clear.
intent_zh: 仰卧拉伸，将一只脚掌翻向俯视镜头。

instruction: The tiger perches on a high diving board edge, one leg dangling, the other foot hooked over the board with the sole turned up to the viewer below.
camera: Worm's-eye view from below the board, sky and pool far away
visibility_requirement: The hooked foot's sole is presented toward the camera with all toes unobstructed.
intent_zh: 坐在跳板边缘，脚掌朝下翻向仰视镜头。

instruction: Kneeling on one knee beside a chalk drawing, the tiger extends the other leg backward and lifts that foot high, sole facing the camera.
camera: Side-low angle at ground level, chalk marks in foreground
visibility_requirement: The lifted rear sole and its four toes are fully visible, not hidden by the body.
intent_zh: 单膝跪地，向后抬脚将脚掌展示给镜头。

instruction: Leaning back in a hammock, the tiger lifts both legs but turns one foot so its sole faces the side viewer while the other foot rests crossed.
camera: Side view at hammock height, fabric curving through frame
visibility_requirement: One sole is sideways to camera and fully visible; the resting foot is not counted.
intent_zh: 吊床侧躺，一只脚掌侧向镜头清晰可见。

instruction: Sitting on a skateboard at a skatepark, the tiger plants one foot on the deck and raises the other leg toward the lens, sole flat.
camera: Ground-level front view, skate ramp curves behind
visibility_requirement: The raised sole is flat toward the lens, four toes spread and fully visible.
intent_zh: 坐在滑板上，将一只脚掌平举向镜头。

instruction: The tiger climbs a rope ladder, pausing to hook one foot on a rung while looking down; the camera above sees that sole from behind.
camera: High angle from above looking down the ladder
visibility_requirement: The hooked sole faces the high camera with all four toes visible between rungs.
intent_zh: 攀爬绳梯，俯视镜头看到勾住的脚掌。

instruction: Stretching on a kitchen counter, the tiger lies on its back with one leg propped against a cabinet, sole facing the viewer.
camera: Frontal waist-height view, cabinets framing the image
visibility_requirement: The propped sole is unobstructed and all four toes are visible against the cabinet.
intent_zh: 躺在台面上把脚抵住柜子，脚掌正对镜头。

instruction: The tiger crouches on a rocky ledge and lifts one hind foot onto a higher stone, sole turned outward to the camera.
camera: Low side angle on the ledge, distant valley behind
visibility_requirement: The outward sole and four toes are clearly visible, not merged with the stone.
intent_zh: 蹲在岩边，把一只脚踩上高处石头并外翻脚掌。

instruction: Reclining on a picnic blanket, the tiger raises one foot toward a friend and flexes the sole wide open, toes spread.
camera: Close low angle across the blanket, grass around
visibility_requirement: The flexed sole is fully open to camera with all four toes separated.
intent_zh: 躺在野餐毯上，向镜头张开脚掌和四趾。

instruction: The tiger sits on a swing and pushes off the ground, one foot extended toward the camera as it swings forward, sole visible.
camera: Front tracking view at swing height, motion in ropes
visibility_requirement: The extended sole faces the camera clearly, toes readable despite the swing.
intent_zh: 荡秋千前推，一只脚掌伸向镜头。

instruction: Standing in a shallow stream, the tiger lifts one foot from the water and turns the sole toward the camera, toes dripping.
camera: Low water-level view, ripples and rocks foreground
visibility_requirement: The wet sole and four toes are fully visible above the waterline.
intent_zh: 站在溪水中抬起一只脚，脚掌朝镜头展示。

instruction: The tiger lies on its side on a couch, one leg raised and bent so the sole faces the room, toes relaxed.
camera: Wide living-room view from floor level, couch dominating frame
visibility_requirement: The bent sole faces the room clearly and all four toes are visible.
intent_zh: 侧躺沙发，弯曲抬脚展示脚掌。

instruction: Perched on a tall bar stool, the tiger crosses one ankle over the other knee and tilts the sole up toward the viewer.
camera: Eye-level close view, bar counter blurred behind
visibility_requirement: The tilted sole faces the camera fully, four toes clear of the opposite leg.
intent_zh: 坐在高脚凳上架腿，把脚掌翻向镜头。

instruction: The tiger does a slow cartwheel in a park and freezes mid-turn, one leg lifted high with its sole facing the camera.
camera: Side action shot frozen mid-motion, trees blurred
visibility_requirement: The raised sole is sharply visible and all four toes clear against the background.
intent_zh: 侧手翻中途定格，高举的脚掌正对镜头。

instruction: Sitting on a dock with legs over the water, the tiger swings one foot up onto the dock, sole turned up to the camera.
camera: Low dock-level view, water reflecting below
visibility_requirement: The upturned sole rests on the dock fully visible with all four toes.
intent_zh: 坐在码头，把脚抬上木板，脚掌朝上展示。

instruction: The tiger kneels on a bed and lifts one lower leg behind, foot sole facing the camera over its shoulder.
camera: Rear three-quarter view at bed height, pillows around
visibility_requirement: The lifted sole faces the rear camera clearly, all four toes unobstructed.
intent_zh: 跪在床上向后抬脚，脚掌越过肩膀朝向镜头。

instruction: Leaning against a wall, the tiger lifts one straight leg to hip height and presses the sole flat toward the viewer.
camera: Frontal eye-level shot, wall texture behind
visibility_requirement: The flat sole is fully visible with four toes spread, nothing blocking it.
intent_zh: 靠墙抬高直腿，脚掌平推镜头。

instruction: The tiger sits in a camping chair and props one foot on the opposite knee, tilting the sole toward a nearby lantern.
camera: Warm side view at chair height, tent fabric behind
visibility_requirement: The tilted sole is lit and fully visible, all four toes clear.
intent_zh: 坐在露营椅上架脚，脚掌被灯光照亮展示。

instruction: Hanging from a playground bar, the tiger swings one leg up and hooks the knee, presenting the sole to the camera.
camera: Low angle from beneath the bars, sky behind
visibility_requirement: The hooked sole is clearly visible from below with all four toes.
intent_zh: 悬挂单杠，勾起膝盖将脚掌展示给下方镜头。

instruction: The tiger lies on a skateboard rolling slowly, one leg lifted so the sole faces the following camera.
camera: Low front tracking shot on smooth pavement
visibility_requirement: The lifted sole stays fully visible to the following camera, four toes clear.
intent_zh: 躺滑板上滑行，抬起脚掌朝向跟拍镜头。

instruction: Squatting beside a campfire, the tiger shifts weight to one leg and lifts the other heel, turning that sole outward to the camera.
camera: Low firelit side angle, embers glowing
visibility_requirement: The outward sole is lit by firelight and fully visible with four toes.
intent_zh: 蹲在篝火旁，外侧脚掌被火光映亮展示。

instruction: The tiger steps out of a car and lifts one foot onto the door sill, sole facing the camera through the open door.
camera: Exterior low angle through open car door
visibility_requirement: The sole on the sill is fully visible, four toes clear of the door frame.
intent_zh: 下车时脚踩门槛，脚掌透过车门朝向镜头。

instruction: Doing a handstand against a wall, the tiger spreads its legs and angles one sole toward the camera.
camera: Wide frontal shot, wall behind, floor below
visibility_requirement: The angled sole is fully visible and all four toes separate clearly.
intent_zh: 倒立靠墙，分开双腿将一只脚掌转向镜头。

instruction: The tiger sits on a staircase and stretches one leg down several steps, sole turned up toward the camera at the bottom.
camera: Low angle up the stairs, steps receding
visibility_requirement: The sole at the bottom of the stretch faces the low camera with four toes visible.
intent_zh: 坐在楼梯上伸腿，脚掌朝下方镜头翻起。

instruction: Reclining on a rooftop, the tiger lifts both feet but rotates one leg so its sole faces the drone camera above.
camera: Aerial drone view looking straight down over rooftops
visibility_requirement: One sole faces the drone fully with all four toes visible; the other foot is not counted.
intent_zh: 躺在屋顶，把一只脚掌转向头顶的无人机镜头。

instruction: The tiger crouches inside a cardboard box and pokes one foot out through a cut hole, sole facing the camera.
camera: Close floor-level view of the box opening
visibility_requirement: The protruding sole is fully visible through the hole with all four toes.
intent_zh: 蹲在纸箱中，从洞口伸出脚掌朝向镜头。

instruction: Leaning back on a gym ball, the tiger balances with one foot lifted off the floor, sole turned to the camera.
camera: Low side view at ball height, gym floor behind
visibility_requirement: The lifted sole is fully visible and all four toes clear of the ball.
intent_zh: 仰靠健身球保持平衡，抬起脚掌展示。

instruction: The tiger lies on its stomach on a rug and bends one knee up, sole facing the ceiling camera while the other leg stays flat.
camera: Overhead view straight down onto the rug
visibility_requirement: The bent sole faces the ceiling camera with all four toes fully visible.
intent_zh: 俯卧地毯，屈膝将脚掌朝天花板镜头展示。

instruction: The blue tiger lies on his back on a gym mat, one leg raised straight up with the sole of his foot facing the camera as he stretches, the other leg bent flat on the mat, arms folded behind his head.
camera: low worm's-eye view looking up along the mat toward the raised sole
visibility_requirement: Raised foot sole and all four toes fully visible; other foot flat and partly hidden is acceptable; hands behind head visible.
intent_zh: 仰卧抬腿拉伸，单脚脚底正对镜头

instruction: The blue tiger balances on a narrow wooden beam, one foot planted and the other lifted behind him with the sole turned outward toward the viewer, arms spread wide for balance, tail curled.
camera: three-quarter side view at beam height, sole angled to lens
visibility_requirement: Lifted rear foot's sole and four toes clearly visible, planted foot fully on beam.
intent_zh: 窄木梁上平衡，后抬脚脚底朝向观众

instruction: The blue tiger crouches beside a shallow stream and lifts one bare foot up over the water, sole facing the camera as he shakes droplets off, the other foot planted on a rock, one hand gripping a reed.
camera: close low angle across the water toward the raised sole
visibility_requirement: Raised sole and four toes clearly presented over water; planted foot visible on rock.
intent_zh: 溪边抬脚甩水，单脚脚底朝镜头

instruction: The blue tiger lies on his side on a picnic blanket, propping himself on one elbow, the top leg bent forward so its sole faces the viewer while the lower leg rests flat, a book open before him.
camera: eye-level lateral view with the top sole as focal point
visibility_requirement: Top foot's sole and four toes fully visible; lower foot partly under body okay; both hands visible.
intent_zh: 侧卧野餐垫，上侧脚底朝向观众翻书

instruction: The blue tiger hangs from a climbing frame by both hands, legs tucked, and twists to push one sole toward the camera, toes spread, the other foot tucked behind the knee.
camera: front low angle looking up at the hanging figure and extended sole
visibility_requirement: Presented sole and all four toes clear against the sky; tucked foot hidden is fine.
intent_zh: 攀爬架悬吊，单脚蹬向镜头张开脚趾

instruction: The blue tiger sits cross-legged on a cushion and rolls one ankle so the sole faces outward to the viewer, examining it with a small mirror held in one hand, the other hand steadying his knee.
camera: medium close overhead-ish three-quarter view onto the sole
visibility_requirement: Turned-up sole and four toes fully visible; mirror hand and knee hand visible.
intent_zh: 盘坐垫上翻脚用镜子查看脚底

instruction: The blue tiger steps down from a ladder, catching himself with one foot braced on a rung behind and sole turned to the viewer, hands gripping the rails, body angled downward.
camera: rear three-quarter angle peering up at the braced sole
visibility_requirement: Braced rear foot sole and four toes clearly visible between rungs; hands on rails visible.
intent_zh: 下梯子时后脚踩横档，脚底朝向镜头

instruction: The blue tiger does a slow cartwheel across grass, captured mid-rotation with one sole arcing toward the camera and the other foot trailing, arms extended, tail sweeping behind.
camera: dynamic low angle frozen mid-motion under the leading sole
visibility_requirement: Leading sole and four toes sharply visible against sky; trailing foot partly blurred acceptable.
intent_zh: 草地侧手翻腾空，领先脚脚底冲向镜头

instruction: The blue tiger lies belly-down at the edge of a rooftop, one leg lifted behind with sole up to the camera, chin on his hand, watching the street below.
camera: behind-and-above view framing the upturned sole and city beyond
visibility_requirement: Upturned sole and four toes fully visible above the ledge; supporting hand and chin hand visible.
intent_zh: 趴屋顶边缘抬脚观望，脚底朝上对镜头

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a swing and kicks one leg high, sole facing the camera at the top of the arc, gripping the ropes with both hands, the other leg hanging.
camera: front view aligned with the kicked sole at swing's apex
visibility_requirement: Kicked foot's sole and all four toes clearly presented; hanging foot visible; hands on ropes.
intent_zh: 秋千上踢腿，高点时脚底正对镜头

instruction: The blue tiger crouches on a boulder at the beach, one foot lifted and turned so its sole faces the lens, the other foot gripping the rock, one hand holding a shell, the other pointing at the pad.
camera: close low angle at boulder height facing the turned sole
visibility_requirement: Turned sole and four toes fully visible; both hands visible with five fingers, one pointing.
intent_zh: 海滩岩石上抬脚指着脚底肉垫

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a low wall and swings both legs, but turns one foot inward so its sole shows to the camera, leaning back on both hands, tail draped over the wall.
camera: front three-quarter view at wall height with sole inward toward lens
visibility_requirement: Inward-turned sole and four toes clearly visible; other foot seen from outside; hands braced visible.
intent_zh: 矮墙坐着摆腿，一脚内翻露出脚底

instruction: The blue tiger steps in fresh mud, then lifts one foot toward the camera to show the sole coated in mud with yellow pads peeking through, other foot still sunk, one hand on hip.
camera: close front low shot on the mud-coated sole
visibility_requirement: Mud-coated sole and all four toes clearly visible with pads discernible; sunk foot partly visible.
intent_zh: 泥地抬脚向镜头展示沾泥的脚底

instruction: The blue tiger balances on a skateboard, one foot planted, the other lifted behind with sole turned to the camera as he coasts, arms out, board tilted under him.
camera: tracking side view at deck height with sole angled to lens
visibility_requirement: Lifted rear sole and four toes clearly visible; planted foot on board visible; arms out.
intent_zh: 滑板滑行，后抬脚脚底朝镜头

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a large tree branch with legs dangling, then draws one knee up and turns that foot so its sole faces the camera, one hand gripping the trunk, the other resting on the branch.
camera: side three-quarter view in the canopy onto the turned sole
visibility_requirement: Drawn-up foot sole and four toes fully visible; dangling foot visible from above; hands clear.
intent_zh: 树枝上收膝翻脚，脚底朝镜头

instruction: The blue tiger stands on one leg in a shallow pool and lifts the other foot up behind his back, sole toward the camera, water dripping, one hand steadying against a rock.
camera: rear three-quarter view at water level toward the raised sole
visibility_requirement: Raised rear sole and four toes clearly visible with drips; standing foot in water visible; bracing hand visible.
intent_zh: 浅池单腿站立，后抬脚脚底朝镜头

instruction: The blue tiger does a backward roll on grass, caught mid-tuck with one sole popping up toward the camera, the other leg wrapped, hands on the ground behind him.
camera: low side angle catching the sole emerging from the tuck
visibility_requirement: Emerging sole and four toes sharply visible; ground hands visible; wrapped leg partly hidden acceptable.
intent_zh: 草地后滚翻，收腿中单脚脚底露出

instruction: The blue tiger sits at a low table and stretches one leg straight out beneath it, tilting the foot so the sole shows to the camera, the other leg folded, one hand holding a teacup.
camera: low table-level angle peeking under the table to the sole
visibility_requirement: Outstretched foot sole and four toes visible under the table; folded leg visible; teacup hand visible.
intent_zh: 矮桌下伸腿，单脚脚底朝向镜头

instruction: The blue tiger leans against a brick wall and lifts one foot to rest its sole flat on the bricks beside him, arms crossed, the other foot planted, head tilted as he looks down.
camera: side-on medium shot framing the wall-pressed sole and crossed arms
visibility_requirement: Wall-pressed sole and four toes fully visible; planted foot visible; crossed arms visible.
intent_zh: 靠墙抬脚抵砖，单脚脚底贴墙

instruction: The blue tiger crouches to inspect a footprint in the snow, comparing it with his own lifted foot turned sole-up toward the camera, one hand on his knee, other pointing down.
camera: over-shoulder low angle onto the lifted sole and the snow print
visibility_requirement: Lifted sole and four toes fully visible above the print; planted foot visible; both hands clear.
intent_zh: 雪地蹲下抬脚比对脚印，脚底朝镜头

instruction: The blue tiger lies on a hammock, one leg slung over the side with the sole facing the camera, the other leg inside, one arm behind his head, the other dangling.
camera: side low angle at hammock height toward the slung sole
visibility_requirement: Slung foot sole and four toes clearly visible over the hammock edge; other foot inside partly hidden okay.
intent_zh: 吊床侧卧搭脚，单脚脚底朝镜头

instruction: The blue tiger kicks a soccer ball with the inside of his foot, captured just after contact with the striking sole turned to the camera, other foot planted, arms balancing.
camera: low front angle just off the kicking foot's line toward the turned sole
visibility_requirement: Kicking foot sole and four toes clearly visible after contact; planted foot visible; ball in frame.
intent_zh: 踢球后单脚脚底转向镜头

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a low wooden bench and lifts both legs forward, pressing the soles of his bare plantigrade feet toward the viewer while leaning back on his hands.
camera: front view, slightly low angle, full body
visibility_requirement: Both soles fully face camera, all four toes per foot clear, hands resting behind on bench visible.
intent_zh: 坐长椅上抬脚展示双脚脚底

instruction: Reclining on a picnic blanket, the blue tiger props himself on elbows and raises both knees, showing the yellow-padded soles of his feet as he smiles at a book propped on his chest.
camera: three-quarter overhead view, full body
visibility_requirement: Both upturned soles and four toes visible; both hands and elbows supporting torso visible.
intent_zh: 躺毯子上屈膝读书露出脚底

instruction: The blue tiger lies on his back on a yoga mat doing a happy-baby stretch, reaching to hold his ankles so both bare soles point upward, toes spread comfortably apart.
camera: top-down view, full body
visibility_requirement: Both soles and all toes face camera; both hands gripping ankles visible.
intent_zh: 仰卧做快乐婴儿式伸展举脚

instruction: Sitting cross-legged on a cushion, the blue tiger leans back and lifts both feet off the floor, turning his soles outward to the camera while balancing a teacup on one knee.
camera: front three-quarter view, seated full body
visibility_requirement: Both soles angled to camera with toes clear; hands and teacup visible.
intent_zh: 盘坐垫子上抬脚露底并平衡茶杯

instruction: Lying on a hammock, the blue tiger swings his legs up over the edge so both bare soles face the viewer, one paw holding the hammock rope and the other resting on his belly.
camera: low front view, full body in hammock
visibility_requirement: Both soles clearly lifted toward camera, four toes each visible; hands visible on rope and belly.
intent_zh: 躺在吊床上抬腿露脚底

visibility_requirement: Both hands at the boot with distinct fingers visible; lifted foot crosses the knee but sole not required.

instruction: Seated on a tall bar stool, the blue tiger reaches both arms across the counter to arrange small glasses, one palm flat on the countertop and the other fingers spread lifting a glass, torso stretched forward.
camera: side medium shot along the counter, glasses in foreground

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a swing seat, legs kicked forward so both soles face the camera, one hand gripping the rope and the other open in a playful stop gesture beside the face.

camera: close three-quarter shot focused on hands and board, face above

instruction: Seated on a flat rock at a riverbank, the blue tiger leans over the water to scoop with cupped hands, both palms facing up and dripping, reflection shimmering below and tail curled on the rock.
camera: high angle from behind the shoulder looking down at cupped hands and water

instruction: A blue tiger lies on its back on a low wooden dock, knees bent and feet planted, one leg lifted high while a long-fingered hand reaches to scratch the lifted foot's sole, head tilted to watch its own foot.
camera: Low three-quarter view from the feet side, wide enough to show both planted legs and the lifted sole
visibility_requirement: The lifted sole faces the camera fully unobstructed, and the scratching hand's fingers are spread clearly beside the foot
intent_zh: 躺在木码头上抬腿挠脚底的舒展姿势

instruction: Reclining on a woven mat, the blue tiger rolls onto its side and props its head on one palm, the other arm draping over its hip; one foot rests atop the other, exposing the upper foot's sole to the viewer.
camera: Eye-level side view, slight downward tilt to read the stacked feet
visibility_requirement: The top foot's sole is fully visible from heel to toes, and both hands are clear of the mat edge
intent_zh: 侧卧撑头、双脚交叠露出脚底的慵懒姿态

instruction: The blue tiger lies face-down on a rug, propped on its elbows, flipping through a large open book with one hand while the opposite bare foot is raised behind it, sole turned toward the ceiling.
camera: High angle looking down over the tiger's back toward the raised foot
visibility_requirement: The raised sole is fully presented to the overhead camera, and the page-turning hand shows all fingers
intent_zh: 趴着看书同时翘起一只脚露脚底

instruction: On a hammock strung between two trees, the blue tiger lies diagonal with one leg hanging out and one arm drooping below, palm open toward the ground, while its other hand grips the hammock edge.
camera: Side view from below the hammock, framing the dangling arm and leg
visibility_requirement: The drooping palm faces the camera with all fingers separated, and the gripping hand is fully visible on the hammock rim
intent_zh: 吊床上斜躺垂手张开手掌

instruction: The blue tiger reclines on a chaise with knees drawn up, using both hands to balance a round clay bowl on its raised knees; one foot is braced flat against the seat cushion, the other lifted showing its sole.
camera: Front three-quarter view at seat height, bowl and lifted sole both in frame
visibility_requirement: Both hands wrap the bowl with fingers visible, and the lifted sole is unobstructed above the cushion
intent_zh: 躺椅上用膝盖顶碗并抬起一只脚

instruction: Lying on its stomach across a wide cushion, the blue tiger reaches one arm forward to poke a sleeping cat toy with a finger, while its feet kick up behind, one sole angled toward the viewer.
camera: Low rear three-quarter view emphasizing the extended arm and the angled sole
visibility_requirement: The poking hand's index finger and all fingers are clear, and the angled sole is fully visible without overlap
intent_zh: 趴着伸手逗玩具、脚翘起露脚底

instruction: Reclining along a tree branch, the blue tiger hangs one leg down and lets its tail curl around the branch; one hand holds a half-peeled orange, the other palm rests open on its chest.
camera: Side view from mid-height, framing the branch, dangling leg and open chest palm
visibility_requirement: The open palm on the chest shows separated fingers, and the orange-holding hand's fingers are visible
intent_zh: 躺在树枝上剥橘子、一手摊在胸前

instruction: The blue tiger lies on its side on a sandy beach, one arm extended overhead with the palm flat in the sand, the other hand drawing a spiral with one finger while both feet rest side by side, upper sole exposed.
camera: High three-quarter view looking down the length of the body toward the overhead palm
visibility_requirement: The overhead palm is flat and fully visible, and the upper foot's sole is exposed above the lower foot
intent_zh: 侧躺沙滩用手掌撑地、手指画圈露脚底

instruction: On a bed of cushions, the blue tiger lies curled with knees near its chest, holding one bare foot in both hands and inspecting its toes; the held sole faces outward.
camera: Close three-quarter view from the foot side, focusing on the held foot and both hands
visibility_requirement: The held sole is turned fully outward, and both hands' fingers are visible wrapping the foot without hiding the pad
intent_zh: 蜷在垫子上双手捧脚检查脚趾

instruction: The blue tiger reclines against a large plush pillow, one leg stretched long and the other folded under, its near hand resting on the floor with palm up holding a small marble.
camera: Low front view at floor level, marble and palm in the foreground, leg line receding
visibility_requirement: The upturned palm with the marble is fully visible and all fingers are distinguishable
intent_zh: 靠着大枕头坐躺、手掌托弹珠

instruction: Lying on a picnic blanket, the blue tiger balances a paper plate on one raised foot's sole while its hands rest behind its head; the plate sits flat on the yellow pads.
camera: Side low view at blanket height, framing the raised foot and the relaxed hands behind the head
visibility_requirement: The raised sole is fully flat toward the sky with the plate balanced on it, and both hands behind the head are visible
intent_zh: 仰躺用脚底顶着纸盘、双手枕在脑后

instruction: The blue tiger lies on its back with a book open on its chest, one hand turning a page while the other hand reaches across to scratch its opposite forearm lazily.
camera: Over-the-shoulder high view looking down at the chest book and both hands
visibility_requirement: Both hands are fully visible above the book, with the page-turning fingers and scratching fingers separated
intent_zh: 仰躺看书翻页、另一手挠手臂

instruction: Reclining on a low wall, the blue tiger swings one leg over the edge and leans back on both palms, head tipped back to look at the sky; one foot dangles with its sole turned toward the viewer.
camera: Low view from the wall's outer side, wall edge horizontal, dangling sole centered
visibility_requirement: The dangling sole faces the viewer unobstructed, and both supporting palms are visible on the wall top
intent_zh: 矮墙上坐着后仰、双手撑墙露脚底

instruction: Lying face-up on a floating pool raft, the blue tiger holds a small watering can with one hand, tipping it toward a potted plant on the pool edge, while its other hand trails in the water.
camera: Side view from water level, framing the raft, can and trailing hand
visibility_requirement: The watering-can hand's fingers grip visibly and the trailing hand's palm is open underwater
intent_zh: 躺在浮床上浇水、一手划水

instruction: The blue tiger lies on its side under a blanket, only one leg and one arm outside; the exposed foot pushes the blanket down with its sole toward the camera, and the hand grips the blanket's edge.
camera: Low side view at blanket level, focusing on the foot and hand emerging from the folds
visibility_requirement: The pushing sole and gripping fingers both emerge clearly from the blanket without fabric hiding the pads
intent_zh: 侧躺盖毯、伸出脚底蹬毯子、手抓毯边

instruction: Reclining on a beanbag chair, the blue tiger leans far back with legs up in the air, one hand holding a small flashlight pointed at its own raised sole, the other hand steadying the beam.
camera: Front low angle, flashlight beam crossing toward the raised sole
visibility_requirement: The illuminated sole faces the camera fully, and both hands around the flashlight are clearly visible
intent_zh: 靠在豆袋椅上抬脚用手电照脚底

instruction: The blue tiger lies on its stomach on a large cushion, elbows planted and chin on one palm, using the other hand to spin a small top on the floor; one heel lifts behind with sole up.
camera: Low front view across the floor, top and spinning hand centered, raised sole behind
visibility_requirement: The spinning hand's fingers are fully visible beside the top, and the raised sole is clear of the cushion
intent_zh: 趴着转陀螺、托腮、脚跟翘起露脚底

instruction: Lying across a wide armchair on its back, the blue tiger folds one leg over the armrest and rests the other foot flat on the seat; one hand dangles to the floor palm-down, the other rests on its stomach.
camera: Side view of the armchair, framing the armrest leg, dangling palm and stomach hand
visibility_requirement: The dangling palm faces away from the body and is fully visible, and the hand on the stomach shows its fingers
intent_zh: 横躺扶手椅、一手垂地、一手放肚子

instruction: Reclining on a flat rock, the blue tiger crosses one ankle over the opposite knee and reaches down with both hands to stretch toward its raised sole, fingers pressing the yellow pads.
camera: Side three-quarter view from the feet, framing the crossed ankle and both reaching hands
visibility_requirement: The raised sole is fully displayed with all pads visible, and both hands' fingers press it clearly
intent_zh: 石头上跷脚、双手够脚底拉伸

instruction: The blue tiger lies on its back on a gym mat, one hand holding a small hand mirror above its face, the other hand tilting the mirror; one knee is bent with the foot planted, and the other leg lies flat.
camera: High three-quarter view from the head end, mirror and both hands in focus
visibility_requirement: Both hands on the mirror are visible with fingers distinct against the frame
intent_zh: 仰躺垫子上双手举镜子端详

instruction: The blue tiger reclines on its side along a couch, one arm bent under its head, the other hand drumming fingers on the cushion; one foot pushes against the far armrest, the near foot resting on the seat.
camera: Side view down the couch length, drumming fingers and head-resting hand both visible
visibility_requirement: The drumming hand's fingers are separated and visible on the cushion, and the head-resting hand is clear
intent_zh: 侧躺沙发、手指敲垫子、一手垫头

instruction: Lying on its stomach on a broad tree branch, the blue tiger reaches one hand down to touch a hanging leaf, the other hand gripping the branch; one foot hooks the branch with sole turned up toward the viewer.
camera: Low upward view from below the branch, framing the reaching hand and upturned sole
visibility_requirement: The reaching hand's fingers touch the leaf clearly, and the hooked foot's sole faces the camera without branch occlusion
intent_zh: 趴在树枝上伸手够叶子、脚勾树枝露脚底

instruction: The blue tiger lies back in a shallow inflatable pool, one hand resting on the pool rim with fingers spread, the other hand cupping water; one leg rests on the rim showing its sole, the other submerged.
camera: Low view across the water toward the pool rim and resting sole
visibility_requirement: The rim-resting sole is fully above water, and the rim hand's spread fingers are unobstructed
intent_zh: 躺在充气池里、一手扶池边、脚搭池沿露脚底

instruction: Curled on a round floor pouf, the blue tiger lies face-down with its chin propped on folded arms, its feet tucked so one sole faces up behind it, toes curled against the fabric.
camera: Rear three-quarter high angle, framing the folded arms and upturned sole
visibility_requirement: The upturned sole is fully visible above the pouf, and both folded hands' fingers are distinct
intent_zh: 趴圆凳上托腮、双脚后翘露脚底

instruction: Reclining on a blanket in tall grass, the blue tiger lies on its back and lifts both legs into the air, one hand supporting its lower back, the other hand reaching up to touch a lifted foot's sole.
camera: Side low view through grass blades, framing both lifted legs and the reaching hand
visibility_requirement: The touched sole faces the camera fully, and the supporting hand is visible under the back
intent_zh: 躺在草丛里举腿、一手撑腰一手摸脚底

instruction: The blue tiger lies on its side on a kitchen floor, one hand propping its head and the other reaching into a low cabinet, fingers visible on the handle; one foot braces the cabinet door.
camera: Low front view at cabinet height, framing the reaching hand and bracing foot
visibility_requirement: The cabinet-reaching hand's fingers are fully visible on the handle, and the head-propping hand is unobstructed
intent_zh: 侧躺厨房地板、伸手开柜门、脚顶柜门

instruction: Lying on a large outdoor cushion, the blue tiger rolls halfway onto its stomach, one arm extended forward with palm open catching a falling leaf, both feet lifted behind with soles upward.
camera: High side view, falling leaf, open palm and both upturned soles in frame
visibility_requirement: The open catching palm faces upward with all fingers separated, and both upturned soles are fully visible
intent_zh: 趴垫子上伸手接落叶、双脚后翘露脚底

instruction: The blue tiger reclines on a wide windowsill, back against the frame, one knee up and the other leg stretched along the sill; one hand taps the glass with a finger, the other hand rests flat on the sill palm-down.
camera: Interior side view along the windowsill, tapping finger and flat palm framed
visibility_requirement: The tapping finger and all fingers of the flat palm are clearly visible against the glass and sill
intent_zh: 坐在窗台上、手指敲玻璃、一手平放窗台

instruction: The blue tiger lounges on a sofa, one arm draped over the backrest with the palm facing the viewer, fingers loosely curled, while the other hand rests on its knee; the head is tilted slightly toward the camera with a calm expression.
camera: medium shot, eye level, slightly angled
visibility_requirement: Both hands fully in frame; one palm clearly facing camera with all five fingers visible.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎慵懒靠在沙发上，一只手掌心朝前搭在椅背，另一只手放在膝盖上，神情放松。

instruction: The blue tiger sits cross-legged on a wooden floor unlacing a boot, leaning forward with one hand gripping the lace and the other palm pressed flat on the floor for balance, all fingertips splayed on the boards.
camera: high-angle medium shot looking down at the seated figure
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible; the splayed palm must show all five fingers on the floor plane.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎盘腿坐地解鞋带，一手抓鞋带，另一手掌平贴地面支撑，手指张开。

instruction: The blue tiger reaches up to a high kitchen shelf, standing on tiptoe with one arm fully extended and palm open toward a jar, the other hand bracing against the counter edge, tail curling for balance.
camera: full-body side view at waist height
visibility_requirement: The reaching hand must be fully visible with palm and five digits clear; the bracing hand also unobstructed.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎踮脚伸手取高处架子上的罐子，另一手扶住台面，尾巴保持平衡。

instruction: The blue tiger crouches beside a low garden bed, gently transplanting a seedling with both hands cupped around the soil, fingers spread under the roots, knees bent in a relaxed plantigrade squat.
camera: close medium shot, slightly above, focused on hands and soil
visibility_requirement: Both cupped hands visible above the soil; all fingers of the upper hand must be countable.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎蹲在花坛边双手捧土移栽幼苗，手指在根部展开。

instruction: The blue tiger balances on a fallen log, arms stretched wide with both palms open and facing forward, one foot lifted mid-step, the other foot planted flat in a natural plantigrade stance.
camera: full-body wide shot, side-on
visibility_requirement: Both open palms must face the camera with five fingers each; neither hand may be cropped.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎在倒木上张开双臂保持平衡，双掌朝前，一只脚抬起迈步。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a park bench reading a paperback, holding the book open in both hands so the palms support the spine and the page, fingers visible along the cover edges, head angled down toward the text.
camera: medium close shot from the front-left
visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping the book must be visible with all fingers of one hand clear along the page.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎坐在公园长椅上读平装书，双手托住书脊翻页，低头看书。

instruction: The blue tiger kneels to pet a housecat, one palm open and lowered toward the cat's head, the other hand flat on its own thigh, back gently curved, feet tucked behind in a plantigrade kneel.
camera: medium shot, low angle near floor level
visibility_requirement: The lowered palm must be fully visible above the cat with all five fingers clear.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎跪在地上伸手抚摸猫的头，另一手放在大腿上，微微弓背。

instruction: The blue tiger stretches after waking, arms raised overhead with palms crossed and fingers interlaced, torso arched, one heel lifting off the floor while toes stay planted in a natural human stretch.
camera: front full-body shot, slightly low angle
visibility_requirement: Both interlaced hands fully visible overhead with all fingers distinguishable.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎睡醒后双手交叉举过头顶伸展，身体后弓，脚跟微抬。

instruction: The blue tiger carries a cardboard box up a short staircase, both hands gripping the underside corners with fingers wrapped around the edges, one foot on a higher step, leaning slightly forward.
camera: three-quarter rear-to-side view, full body
visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping the box corners must be visible with fingers wrapped and countable.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎双手托住纸箱底部上楼梯，手指扣住箱角，身体前倾。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on the floor playing a hand drum, one palm raised mid-strike with fingers spread, the other palm flat on the drum skin, legs folded loosely in front.
camera: medium shot from slightly above, facing the drum
visibility_requirement: Both palms visible over the drum; the raised hand must show all five spread fingers.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎坐地拍手鼓，一只手掌抬起张开，另一手掌按在鼓面上。

instruction: The blue tiger lies on its side on a picnic blanket, propped on one elbow with that palm flat on the blanket, the other hand tossing a grape upward, legs bent comfortably.
camera: low eye-level medium wide shot
visibility_requirement: The propping palm and the tossing hand must both be visible with all fingers clear.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎侧躺在野餐毯上，一手撑地，另一手向上抛葡萄。

instruction: The blue tiger leans over a balcony railing to water potted plants, one hand tipping a watering can with fingers wrapped around the handle, the other palm resting on the rail, body angled outward.
camera: medium shot from inside the balcony, slightly behind
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible on the can and rail; fingers on the handle must be countable.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎在阳台探身给盆栽浇水，一手握水壶把手，一手扶栏杆。

instruction: The blue tiger sits in a rocking chair knitting, holding two needles with yarn looped over the fingers, both palms angled toward the camera as the shawl grows in its lap.
camera: medium close shot from the front
visibility_requirement: Both hands holding needles must be visible with fingers looped through yarn and countable.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎坐在摇椅上织毛线，双手持针，毛线绕在手指上。

instruction: The blue tiger climbs a short ladder to a loft, one hand gripping a rung above with fingers curled over it, the other palm pushing against the side rail, one foot on a lower rung.
camera: low-angle full-body shot looking up the ladder
visibility_requirement: The upper gripping hand must be fully visible with all fingers curled over the rung.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎爬短梯上阁楼，一手抓横档，另一手推侧栏。

instruction: The blue tiger sits at a cafe table stirring tea, one hand curled around the cup handle with the palm visible, the other hand holding a spoon mid-stir, head turned slightly toward a window.
camera: medium close shot across the table
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible around cup and spoon; the cup-holding palm must show all five fingers.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎坐咖啡馆桌边搅茶，一手握杯柄露出掌心，一手拿勺。

instruction: The blue tiger does a gentle forward fold yoga pose, palms pressed flat on a mat in front of the feet, fingers spread wide, heels lifted slightly as the torso hangs relaxed.
camera: side view, low angle near the mat
visibility_requirement: Both flat palms on the mat must be fully visible with all five spread fingers each.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎做前屈瑜伽，双掌平贴垫子手指张开，脚跟微抬。

instruction: The blue tiger pushes a shopping cart through a grocery aisle, both hands wrapped around the handlebar with palms facing down, one foot stepping forward mid-stride in a natural walk.
camera: three-quarter front view, full body
visibility_requirement: Both hands on the handlebar must be visible with fingers wrapped and countable.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎推购物车在超市过道走，双手握把手，一脚迈步。

instruction: The blue tiger crouches to tie a child's shoelace, one hand pulling the loop with fingers pinched, the other palm flat on the floor, both feet planted flat behind in a deep squat.
camera: low side view near floor level
visibility_requirement: The pinching hand and the flat supporting palm must both be visible with fingers clear.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎蹲下帮孩子系鞋带，一手捏鞋带圈，一掌平放地面。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a low wall swinging its legs, one hand shading its eyes with the palm flat above the brow, the other hand resting beside a hip with fingers relaxed over the edge.
camera: medium wide shot from the front at seated eye level
visibility_requirement: The shading palm must be fully visible above the brow with five fingers; the resting hand also clear.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎坐在矮墙上晃腿，一手遮阳搭在额前，一手放在身侧。

instruction: The blue tiger holds a camera to its eye photographing a bird, one palm cupping the lens barrel with fingers wrapped, the other hand gripping the body, elbows tucked, leaning slightly forward.
camera: medium close shot from the side
visibility_requirement: Both hands on the camera must be visible with fingers countable around lens and body.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎举相机拍鸟，一手托镜头，一手握机身，身体前倾。

instruction: The blue tiger kneels to scrub a floor with a brush, one palm flat on the boards pressing down, the other hand gripping the brush handle, shoulders lowered and feet tucked plantigrade behind.
camera: high-angle medium shot looking down
visibility_requirement: The flat pressing palm must show all five fingers on the floor; the brush hand also visible.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎跪地刷地板，一掌平压地面，一手握刷柄。

instruction: The blue tiger leans against a doorframe stretching one calf, one palm braced flat on the wall at shoulder height, the other hand on its hip, rear leg extended back with the foot flat.
camera: full-body side view from the wall side
visibility_requirement: The wall-braced palm must be fully visible with spread fingers; the hip hand also clear.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎靠门框拉伸小腿，一掌撑墙，一手叉腰，后脚掌贴地。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a stool restringing a guitar, one hand threading a string through the peg with fingertips pinched, the other palm steadying the neck from below, head bent close.
camera: medium close shot from the front-right
visibility_requirement: The pinching hand must show all fingertips clearly; the supporting palm under the neck visible.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎坐凳子上给吉他换弦，一手捏弦穿弦钮，一手托琴颈。

instruction: The blue tiger lies on its stomach on a rug doing a crossword, one palm flat on the paper holding it down, the other hand holding a pencil poised above a square, feet raised and crossed behind.
camera: high-angle shot over the shoulder
visibility_requirement: The flat holding palm must show five fingers on the paper; the pencil hand also visible.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎趴在地毯上填字谜，一掌按纸，一手握铅笔，双脚交叉抬起。

instruction: The blue tiger steps out of a shallow stream onto a bank, one hand gripping a tree root with fingers curled, the other palm open for balance, one foot lifted and dripping mid-step.
camera: full-body low angle from the bank
visibility_requirement: The root-gripping hand and the open balancing palm must both be visible with fingers clear.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎从浅溪跨上岸，一手抓树根，一手张开保持平衡。

instruction: The blue tiger sits at a piano playing a soft chord, both palms curved over the keys with fingers gently spread on the white notes, head tilted toward the music stand.
camera: medium shot from the side above the keyboard
visibility_requirement: Both hands on the keys must be fully visible with all fingers resting on separate keys.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎坐在钢琴前弹和弦，双手掌弓起手指分布在琴键上。

instruction: The blue tiger crouches on a beach building a sandcastle, both hands patting the wet sand into a tower, palms cupped and fingers spread, knees bent in a low plantigrade squat.
camera: medium close, low angle at sand level
visibility_requirement: Both cupped hands must be visible on the sand tower with all fingers countable.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎蹲在沙滩堆沙堡，双手拍实湿沙，手指展开。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a bed folding laundry, one palm smoothing a shirt flat on the mattress, the other hand tucking a sleeve corner with fingers pinched, legs folded to one side.
camera: medium shot from slightly above the bed
visibility_requirement: The smoothing palm must be flat and fully visible with five fingers; the tucking hand also clear.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎坐在床上叠衣服，一掌抚平衬衫，一手捏袖角。

instruction: The blue tiger hangs a picture on a wall, one hand holding the frame level with fingers gripping the edge, the other hand pressing a nail with the palm braced flat beside it.
camera: medium shot from behind and to the side
visibility_requirement: The frame-gripping hand must show all fingers on the edge; the bracing palm must be flat and visible.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎往墙上挂画，一手扶画框边，一掌撑墙按钉子。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on the floor with a laptop, typing with one hand while the other palm rests flat on the trackpad, fingers spread, legs crossed loosely.
camera: medium close over the shoulder, slightly high
visibility_requirement: The typing hand's fingers and the flat trackpad palm must both be visible and countable.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎坐地用小电脑，一手打字，一掌平放触控板手指展开。

instruction: The blue tiger kneels to lace a hiking boot, one hand pulling the lace taut with fingers hooked, the other palm flat on its raised knee, one foot resting on a rock in front.
camera: three-quarter medium shot at knee height
visibility_requirement: The lace-pulling hand and the palm on the knee must both be visible with fingers clear.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎跪着系登山靴鞋带，一手拉紧鞋带，一掌平放膝盖。

instruction: The blue tiger crouches low on a rocky trail, one knee near the ground, reaching forward with an open right palm to touch a mossy boulder. Left hand rests on the raised knee. Tail curls behind for balance.
camera: low three-quarter front shot, eye level with the crouched figure
visibility_requirement: Both hands fully in frame; right palm and all five fingers clear, left hand visible on knee
intent_zh: 在岩石小径上低蹲，右掌张开触碰苔藓巨石，左掌扶膝。

instruction: The blue tiger balances on a narrow fallen log crossing a stream, arms spread wide horizontally, one foot lifted mid-step. Body leans slightly forward, eyes down at the water. Tail extended straight behind.
camera: side profile medium-wide shot, log horizontal across frame
visibility_requirement: Both spread hands visible at full length; fingers separated and countable
intent_zh: 在横跨溪流的倒木上张臂平衡，一脚抬起。

instruction: The blue tiger presses both open palms flat against a tall glass wall, leaning close to peer inside, one foot forward and one back in a lunge. Fingers splayed wide on the glass surface.

visibility_requirement: Both hands clearly visible on the sand; feet outside frame.
intent_zh: 蓝虎在沙地上画螺旋图案。

instruction: The blue tiger leans out over a wooden railing to feed a bird perched on a post below, one hand extended with crumbs, body angled forward, gaze following the bird.
camera: medium shot from the side, railing and post in frame
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible, one over the railing and one on it.
intent_zh: 蓝虎靠在木栏杆上喂鸟。

instruction: The blue tiger wedges a shoulder against a heavy wooden crate, pushing it across a plank floor, both hands flat on the side, legs braced in a wide stance with effort.
camera: low wide shot from front-right, crate and floor visible
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible pressing the crate; feet not shown.
intent_zh: 蓝虎用肩膀和双手推木箱。

instruction: The blue tiger hides behind a large potted fern, peeking out with one eye visible between leaves, one hand parting the fronds, body mostly concealed in the dim room.
camera: eye-level medium shot through the leaves
visibility_requirement: One parting hand visible; the other arm occluded by foliage.
intent_zh: 蓝虎躲在蕨类植物后探头偷看。

instruction: The blue tiger threads a needle by a window, holding the needle close to one eye and the thread pinched in the other hand, mouth slightly open in concentration.
camera: extreme close-up of face and hands, window light from behind
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible at chest height; lower body out of frame.
intent_zh: 蓝虎对着窗光穿针引线。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a stack of crates with legs dangling over the edge, leaning back on one hand and holding a lantern up with the other, lighting the rafters above.
camera: low angle from below, crates and rafters framing the shot
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible, one bracing on the crate top.
intent_zh: 蓝虎坐在木箱堆上举着灯笼照亮房梁。

instruction: The blue tiger clambers over a low garden wall, belly and knees on the stone cap, one hand swinging over while the other grips the edge, tail flicking up.
camera: side view slightly behind, wall cutting the frame
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible on the wall edge; legs partly hidden by the wall.
intent_zh: 蓝虎翻越低矮花园石墙。

instruction: The blue tiger scrubs a stubborn stain from a large pot, both hands gripping a brush, shoulders hunched, water splashing onto the floor around the base of the pot.
camera: medium shot from front-high angle, pot and brush in focus
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible on the brush; feet outside frame.
intent_zh: 蓝虎用力刷洗大锅上的污渍。

instruction: The blue tiger winds a long rope around one forearm and elbow, pulling it taut with the other hand, leaning back with weight on the heels, face turned to the side.
camera: side-angle medium shot, rope looping through the frame
visibility_requirement: Both hands clear of the rope confusion and visible.
intent_zh: 蓝虎把长绳缠在小臂上拉紧。

instruction: The blue tiger drops through a trapdoor in the floor, only head, shoulders and one gripping hand visible at the opening, eyes wide with surprise as the room recedes.
camera: high angle looking down into the room from above
visibility_requirement: One hand gripping the trapdoor edge visible; other arm below the floor.
intent_zh: 蓝虎从地板暗门跌落，仅露头肩和一只手。

instruction: The blue tiger crawls through a low tunnel of roots and earth, face forward near the camera, one hand reaching ahead into the darker passage.
camera: front-on low view inside the tunnel, shallow depth
visibility_requirement: One advancing hand visible ahead; the trailing arm hidden by the body.
intent_zh: 蓝虎在树根土洞中匍匐前进。

instruction: The blue tiger leans over a bridge rail to watch its reflection in still water, one hand trailing just above the surface, the other holding the rail, ears perked.
camera: high angle over the rail, face and reflection framed together
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible, one on the rail and one above water.
intent_zh: 蓝虎靠桥栏看水中倒影。

instruction: The blue tiger pries open a wooden chest with both hands, leaning its weight into the lid, face lit from the glow spilling out, shoulders squared with effort.
camera: front-low angle, chest and glowing light dominating
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible gripping the lid edge.
intent_zh: 蓝虎双手撬开发光木箱。

instruction: The blue tiger trips over a coiled garden hose and pitches forward, arms flailing, one knee bent to catch itself, mouth open in a startled shout.
camera: wide side shot, hose and path in frame
visibility_requirement: Both flailing hands visible; feet not shown.
intent_zh: 蓝虎被水管绊倒向前扑。

instruction: The blue tiger squeezes through a partially open window, shoulders twisted, one hand on the frame and the other reaching toward the room inside, tail caught behind.
camera: from inside the room, window framing the body
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible on the frame and sill; lower body outside.
intent_zh: 蓝虎扭身从半开窗户挤进房间。

instruction: The blue tiger hangs upside down from a sturdy branch by both hands, knees hooked over the limb, examining a bird's nest below with an upside-down curious expression.
camera: inverted low angle looking up past the branch
visibility_requirement: Both gripping hands visible on the branch; legs behind the limb.
intent_zh: 蓝虎倒挂在树枝上看鸟巢。

instruction: The blue tiger crouches behind a curtain, only the head and one hand poking out as it watches someone cross the room, eyes narrowed and alert.
camera: medium shot from the room, curtain edge in foreground
visibility_requirement: One peeking hand visible outside the curtain; other arm hidden.
intent_zh: 蓝虎躲在帘后偷看房间动静。

instruction: The blue tiger swings a long-handled axe down upon a piece of firewood on a chopping block, torso twisted, both hands gripping the haft, chips flying from the block.
camera: low angle from the side, axe arc and block visible
visibility_requirement: Both hands clearly visible on the axe handle.
intent_zh: 蓝虎挥斧劈柴，木屑飞溅。

instruction: The blue tiger lies on its back beneath a low wooden cart, arms extended up, working on an axle with a small wrench in one hand and a bolt in the other.
camera: low side view under the cart, wheels framing the scene
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible against the underside of the cart.
intent_zh: 蓝虎躺在车底修理车轴。

instruction: The blue tiger reaches into a deep barrel of grain, one arm sunk to the elbow, face turned away with a grimace, the other hand steadying the barrel rim.
camera: medium front angle, barrel dominating the lower frame
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible, one at the barrel rim and one entering it.
intent_zh: 蓝虎伸手探入谷桶深处。

instruction: The blue tiger steps carefully along a narrow stone ledge on a steep wall, back pressed to the rock, one hand flat against the wall and the other pointing ahead for balance.
camera: wide side view showing the drop beyond the ledge
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible against the wall and ahead; feet on the ledge.
intent_zh: 蓝虎背贴岩壁在窄石沿侧移。

instruction: The blue tiger ducks under a low doorway carrying a stack of books, chin pressing the top book down, both hands wrapped around the wobbling tower.
camera: front-three-quarter medium shot, doorway framing
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible supporting the stack; feet out of frame.
intent_zh: 蓝虎低头抱着一摞书过矮门。

instruction: The blue tiger slumps back against a boulder after a long climb, chest heaving, one forearm across a raised knee, the other hand resting on the ground beside it, eyes half-closed.
camera: low side angle, boulder and distant ridge behind
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible, one on the knee arm and one on the ground.
intent_zh: 蓝虎登山后在巨石旁瘫坐喘息。

instruction: The blue tiger peers into a telescope aimed out a round attic window, one hand adjusting the focus knob, the other bracing the tube, one eye squinting into the eyepiece.
camera: profile medium shot, telescope pointing to window
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible on the telescope body and knob.
intent_zh: 蓝虎在阁楼用望远镜观测窗外。

instruction: The blue tiger drags a heavy sack across a wooden dock toward a waiting boat, leaning back into the pull, both hands gripping the sack's tied neck, rope trailing behind.
camera: wide low shot along the dock planks
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible on the sack neck; feet on the planks.
intent_zh: 蓝虎在码头上拖着沉重麻袋走向小船。

instruction: The blue tiger crouches low on a rocky ledge, one knee near the ground, peering over the edge with narrowed eyes while its tail curls upward behind it.
camera: three-quarter low-angle medium shot from the side
visibility_requirement: Both hands tucked near the chest and feet flat on the ledge, not clearly visible; identity and style only.
intent_zh: 蓝色老虎蹲在岩壁上警觉地向边缘张望，保持角色身份与赛璐璐风格。

instruction: The blue tiger leans far back in a wooden chair, balancing it on two rear legs, one arm flung out for balance and the other gripping the seat edge.
camera: full-body side view at chair height
visibility_requirement: Both hands clearly visible gripping and reaching; feet obscured behind the chair.
intent_zh: 老虎把木椅向后倾斜保持平衡，双手清晰可见。

instruction: The blue tiger hangs upside down from a horizontal tree branch by its knees, arms dangling toward the ground and ears flipped forward as it grins.
camera: low-angle full-body shot looking up
visibility_requirement: Both dangling hands fully visible; knees grip branch, feet not shown.
intent_zh: 老虎用膝弯倒挂在树枝上，双臂下垂，双手可见。

instruction: The blue tiger sits cross-legged on a woven mat, holding a small clay cup in both paws and blowing gently across its rim, tail wrapped around one leg.
camera: eye-level medium shot
visibility_requirement: Both hands wrapped around the cup with all fingers visible; feet crossed and hidden.
intent_zh: 老虎盘腿坐着双手捧杯轻吹，双手手指清晰。

instruction: The blue tiger kneels to sketch on paper spread over the floor, one hand steadying the sheet and the other holding a stick of charcoal above it.
camera: high-angle over-the-shoulder shot
visibility_requirement: Both hands visible from above, fingers distinct around paper and charcoal; feet folded beneath, hidden.
intent_zh: 老虎跪地画画，双手与手指从上方清晰可见。

instruction: The blue tiger reclines on a hammock strung between two trees, one leg draped over the edge, reading a small book held above its face.
camera: side medium shot at hammock height
visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping the book visibly; draped foot turned away and not assessable.
intent_zh: 老虎躺在吊床上看书，双手握书清晰可见。

instruction: The blue tiger scrambles up a steep sandy bank, claws digging in, body angled diagonally and tail trailing downward.
camera: low-angle three-quarter view from below
visibility_requirement: Both hands digging into sand clearly visible with fingers spread; feet behind body, hidden.
intent_zh: 老虎攀爬陡峭沙坡，双爪抓沙清晰，手指可见。

instruction: The blue tiger lies on its side on a smooth floor, one arm tucked under its head and the other hand tapping a small drum beside it.
camera: high-angle top-down shot
visibility_requirement: Tapping hand and tucked hand both visible from above; feet out of frame.
intent_zh: 老虎侧躺敲小鼓，双手从俯视角度清晰。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on a swivel stool at a workbench, leaning close to inspect a tiny gear held in one paw while the other steadies a magnifier.
camera: close-up over-the-shoulder view
visibility_requirement: Both hands near the face clearly visible, fingers distinct around gear and magnifier; feet hidden.
intent_zh: 老虎坐在工作台前仔细检查齿轮，双手与手指清晰。

instruction: The blue tiger leans out from a rooftop edge, one hand shading its eyes and the other gripping the ledge, city rooftops stretching behind.
camera: wide rear three-quarter shot
visibility_requirement: Shading hand and gripping hand visible over the ledge; lower body below parapet, feet hidden.
intent_zh: 老虎从屋顶边缘探身远望，双手可见。

instruction: The blue tiger tucks into a tight forward roll across a gym mat, body curled and tail wrapped close, mid-tumble motion.
camera: side low-angle action shot
visibility_requirement: Limbs tucked into the roll and not individually assessable; identity and style only.
intent_zh: 老虎在垫子上前滚翻，身体蜷缩，保持身份与风格。

instruction: The blue tiger perches atop a tall ladder, one leg hooked over a rung, both hands folding a large paper map.
camera: side full-body shot at ladder height
visibility_requirement: Both hands folding the map clearly visible; hooked foot turned away, not assessable.
intent_zh: 老虎坐在梯子上折地图，双手与手指清晰。

instruction: The blue tiger stands at an easel outdoors, one hand steadying a palette and the other raising a brush toward the canvas.
camera: front three-quarter medium shot
visibility_requirement: Palette hand and brush hand both fully visible with fingers distinct; feet behind easel, hidden.
intent_zh: 老虎在户外画架前作画，双手与手指清晰。

instruction: The blue tiger crouches behind a low wall in a snowfield, one hand pressed to the snow for support and the other raised to shield its face from falling flakes.
camera: side medium shot at wall height
visibility_requirement: Supporting hand and shielding hand both visible with fingers distinct; feet behind wall, hidden.
intent_zh: 老虎躲在雪地矮墙后抬手挡雪，双手可见。

instruction: The blue tiger swings hand-over-hand along a rope bridge, body stretched between rungs, tail swinging with the motion.
camera: low-angle full-body shot from below the bridge
visibility_requirement: Both gripping hands clearly visible above on the rope; feet dangling but not turned to camera.
intent_zh: 老虎沿绳桥交替攀荡，双手抓绳清晰。

instruction: The blue tiger sits on the floor assembling a model ship, one hand holding the hull and the other pinching a tiny mast into place.
camera: close high-angle shot over the shoulder
visibility_requirement: Both hands and fingers clearly visible around the model; feet crossed under body, hidden.
intent_zh: 老虎坐地拼装模型船，双手与手指清晰。

instruction: The blue tiger vaults over a park bench sideways, one hand planted on the backrest and legs swept horizontally.
camera: side action shot at bench height
visibility_requirement: Planted hand visible on the backrest; other hand and feet blurred in motion, not assessable.
intent_zh: 老虎侧身跃过公园长椅，支撑手可见。

instruction: The blue tiger stands on a drifting raft, one hand holding a long pole and the other cupped around its mouth as it calls across the water.
camera: wide three-quarter shot from the shore
visibility_requirement: Pole hand and cupped hand both clearly visible with fingers; feet planted on raft, not assessable.
intent_zh: 老虎站在木筏上撑杆呼喊，双手清晰可见。

instruction: The blue tiger bends deeply at the waist to inspect a flower, one hand on its knee and the other gently lifting a petal.
camera: side medium shot at waist height
visibility_requirement: Knee hand and petal-lifting hand clearly visible with fingers; feet planted and out of frame.
intent_zh: 老虎弯腰细看花朵，双手可见。

instruction: The blue tiger sits back-to-back with a large stone statue, mimicking its pose with arms folded and chin lifted proudly.
camera: wide side shot at statue height
visibility_requirement: Folded arms and hands visible against the statue backdrop; legs folded under, feet hidden.
intent_zh: 老虎背靠石像模仿其姿态，双手交叠可见。
